WHERE t.new_year::integer=EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date)::integer AND t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
-- 目标先按商机＋年取最新。空商机ID以目标ID独立保留，避免全部空ID挤成一条。
),
target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT t.target_id,t.account_id,
       CASE WHEN pt.type_code IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN pt.type_code IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他' END AS product_type,COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(owned.team_name),''),ot.team_name) AS team_name,
       v.amount_yuan::numeric/100000000::numeric AS amount_yi,
       v.power_value::numeric/p.target_power_units_per_gwh AS energy_gwh
FROM target_rows t CROSS JOIN context p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (1,t.new_month1,t.new_month1_power),
(2,t.new_month2,t.new_month2_power),
(3,t.new_month3,t.new_month3_power),
(4,t.new_month4,t.new_month4_power),
(5,t.new_month5,t.new_month5_power),
(6,t.new_month6,t.new_month6_power),
(7,t.new_month7,t.new_month7_power),
(8,t.new_month8,t.new_month8_power),
(9,t.new_month9,t.new_month9_power),
(10,t.new_month10,t.new_month10_power),
(11,t.new_month11,t.new_month11_power),
(12,t.new_month12,t.new_month12_power)) v(month_no,amount_yuan,power_value)
LEFT JOIN product_types pt USING(product_type_id) LEFT JOIN owner_teams ot USING(owner_id)
LEFT JOIN teams owned ON owned.team_id=t.owning_team_id
WHERE t.rn=1 AND make_date(t.year_no,v.month_no,1)>=p.year_start
  AND make_date(t.year_no,v.month_no,1)<p.next_year_start
-- B01/C03为年度目标，即使以后把起止改为月，也不把年度目标误缩为单月目标。
),
customer_target AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT account_id,product_type,SUM(amount_yi) AS target_amount,SUM(energy_gwh) AS target_energy
FROM target_facts GROUP BY account_id,product_type
),
customer_forecast AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT account_id,product_type,SUM(amount_yi) AS forecast_amount,SUM(energy_gwh) AS forecast_energy
FROM forecast_facts GROUP BY account_id,product_type
),
customer_gaps AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT k.account_id,a.account_name,k.product_type,
 t.target_amount,f.forecast_amount,t.target_amount-f.forecast_amount AS gap_amount,
 t.target_energy,f.forecast_energy,t.target_energy-f.forecast_energy AS gap_energy
FROM (
 SELECT account_id,product_type FROM customer_target WHERE account_id IS NOT NULL
 UNION SELECT account_id,product_type FROM customer_forecast WHERE account_id IS NOT NULL
) k
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id=k.account_id
LEFT JOIN customer_target t ON t.account_id=k.account_id AND t.product_type=k.product_type
LEFT JOIN customer_forecast f ON f.account_id=k.account_id AND f.product_type=k.product_type
-- 按客户ID＋电芯/PACK/其他分别对齐目标与预测，不能先按客户合计再复制到产品组。
-- 任一侧缺值时相应差额保持NULL，不以0替代未映射目标或预测。
),
metric_results AS (
SELECT 9 AS sort_no,'R08'::text AS code,'客户目标、商机预测及缺口'::text AS metric_name,
NULL::text AS product_team,
(SUM(g.gap_amount))::numeric AS amount_yi,(SUM(g.gap_energy))::numeric AS energy_gwh,(COUNT(*))::bigint AS item_count,
(NULL)::numeric AS ratio_value,(NULL)::numeric AS days_value,'已按客户和产品拆分；缺口完整性见明细'::text AS status,
'客户ID＋产品类型分别计算目标－预测。金额、电量分开计算；缺任一侧则该组差额NULL。客户/电芯/PACK逐项结果在分组明细；主列是可计算配对的部分合计。'::text AS note,(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(g)))::jsonb AS detail
FROM customer_gaps g
)
SELECT r.code AS "指标序号",r.metric_name AS "指标名称",r.product_team AS "产品团队",
p.start_date AS "期间开始",p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",r.item_count AS "数量",
r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
CASE WHEN r.status='查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' THEN
 CASE WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
        OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围' END ELSE r.status END AS "计算说明状态",
r.note AS "取值说明",r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results r CROSS JOIN context p ORDER BY r.sort_no,r.product_team NULLS LAST;;

R09.caliber: 客户等级0/核心大客户及1/战略大客户中，不存在new_opportunitystatus=0在跟商机的客户，按客户ID去重；还按客户.createdon落所选期间。

R09.sql:
-- 指标 R09 待突破的战略客户数：可直接调用 SQL（PostgreSQL 只读；业务表均为 ded_public）
-- 来源：穿透式分析_55种指标_查询_2025_C0及环节周期合并修订.sql 第 10 个指标分支；仅保留该指标依赖的 7 个 CTE，结果与整段执行时该指标的行一致。
-- 修改统计期间：只改 parameters 中的 start_date / end_exclusive（结束日不含）；无绑定参数。
WITH
parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive,
       CURRENT_TIMESTAMP::timestamp AS observed_at,
       ARRAY['1']::text[] AS strategic_levels,
       ARRAY['1','2']::text[] AS focus_levels,
       1000000::numeric AS target_power_units_per_gwh
-- 默认2025全年；结束日不含。仅修改这里，不需要填写绑定参数。
-- 战略客户默认等级1；重点跟踪默认1战略＋2重要。0核心/4BG不自动纳入。
-- 目标power暂沿用当前M0007单项的kWh换算，不用quantity冒充电量。
),
context AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT p.*,LEAST(observed_at,end_exclusive::timestamp) AS cutoff,
       make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1) AS year_start,
       make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer+1,1,1) AS next_year_start,
       GREATEST(0::numeric,LEAST(1::numeric,
        (LEAST(observed_at,end_exclusive::timestamp)::date-make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1))::numeric
        /(make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer+1,1,1)-make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1)))) AS time_progress
FROM parameters p
),
account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT a.accountid::text AS account_id,a.name::text AS account_name,
       a.new_accountlevel::text AS level_code,
       a.new_sapdate::timestamp AS sap_created_at,a.new_sapsubmitdate::timestamp AS sap_submitted_at,
       a.new_approved_time_facreview::timestamp AS account_factory_approved_at,
       a.new_submit_time_facreview::timestamp AS account_factory_submitted_at,
       a.new_sinosurestartdate::timestamp AS account_sinosure_start,
       a.new_sinosureenddate::timestamp AS account_sinosure_end,
       a.new_submit_time_accredit::timestamp AS account_credit_submitted_at,
       a.new_approvaltime_accredit::timestamp AS account_credit_approved_at,
       a.new_cdastartdate::timestamp AS account_cda_start,
       a.new_cdaenddate::timestamp AS account_cda_end,
       a.new_cda_submittime::timestamp AS account_cda_submitted_at,
       a.new_cda_approved_time::timestamp AS account_cda_approved_at,

       a.new_sapcode::text AS sap_code,a.new_issap::text AS sap_registered,
       a.new_issapnew::text AS sap_registration_kind,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY a.accountid ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST,a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb a WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(a.accountid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT account_id,account_name,level_code,sap_created_at,sap_submitted_at,account_factory_approved_at,account_factory_submitted_at,account_sinosure_start,account_sinosure_end,account_credit_submitted_at,account_credit_approved_at,account_cda_start,account_cda_end,account_cda_submitted_at,account_cda_approved_at,account_factory_approval_status,sap_code,sap_registered,sap_registration_kind FROM account_rows WHERE rn=1
),
opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.opportunityid::text AS opportunity_id,o.parentaccountid::text AS account_id,
       o.name::text AS project_name,o.ownerid::text AS owner_id,
       CASE WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯'
            WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS product_type,
       o.new_isqualifiedsuppliers::text AS supplier_flag,
       o.new_istechnologyagreement::text AS technical_flag,
       o.new_iswarranty::text AS warranty_flag,
       o.new_processstage::text AS process_stage,o.statecode::text AS system_state,o.new_demandinput::text AS demand_status,
       o.createdon::timestamp AS created_at,o.new_stage1enddate::timestamp AS s1,
       o.new_stage2enddate::timestamp AS s2,o.new_stage3enddate::timestamp AS s3,
       o.new_stage4enddate::timestamp AS s4,o.new_stage5enddate::timestamp AS s5,
       o.new_cdastartdate::timestamp AS new_cdastartdate,
       o.new_cdaenddate::timestamp AS new_cdaenddate,
       o.new_approved_time_acneed::timestamp AS new_approved_time_acneed,
       o.new_submit_time_acneed::timestamp AS new_submit_time_acneed,
       o.new_issalesforecast_date::timestamp AS new_issalesforecast_date,

       o.new_submit_time_projectassess::timestamp AS new_submit_time_projectassess,

       o.new_sampletime::timestamp AS new_sampletime,
       o.new_technicalsigningdate::timestamp AS new_technicalsigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_techcon::timestamp AS new_submit_time_techcon,
       o.new_warrantysigningdate::timestamp AS new_warrantysigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_qsl::timestamp AS new_submit_time_qsl,
       o.new_isneedcda::text AS new_isneedcda,
       o.new_approvalstatus_acneed::text AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
       o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess::text AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
       o.new_approvalstatus_techcon::text AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
       o.new_approvalstatus_qsl::text AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
       o.new_sampletestresult::text AS new_sampletestresult,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY o.opportunityid ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST,o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb o
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(o.opportunityid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
bid_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT b.project_name::text AS project_name,b.seq_no::text AS bid_id,b.seq_no AS bid_seq,b.remark::text AS remark,
       NULLIF(BTRIM(b.input_time::text),'')::timestamp AS input_at,
       NULLIF(BTRIM(b.bid_open_time::text),'')::timestamp AS open_at,
       NULLIF(BTRIM(b.winner_announce_time::text),'')::timestamp AS result_at
FROM ded_public.p_fm_bid_project_info b
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(b.project_name::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
customer_coverage AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT a.account_id,a.account_name,a.level_code,
 COUNT(DISTINCT o.opportunity_id) AS opportunity_count,
 COUNT(DISTINCT o.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE b.project_name IS NOT NULL) AS entered_count,
 COUNT(DISTINCT o.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE o.product_type='电芯') AS cell_opportunity_count,
 COUNT(DISTINCT o.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE o.product_type='PACK') AS pack_opportunity_count
FROM accounts a CROSS JOIN context p
LEFT JOIN opportunity_rows o ON o.account_id=a.account_id AND o.rn=1
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT project_name FROM bid_rows) b ON b.project_name=o.project_name
WHERE a.level_code=ANY(p.strategic_levels)
GROUP BY a.account_id,a.account_name,a.level_code
-- 客户为底表：客户.accountid＝商机.parentaccountid。
-- 商机.name＝投标.project_name，原值精确匹配；不要求物理外键约束。
-- 统计关联现状，不用客户/商机创建年份、审批状态或预测记录存在性筛掉客户。
-- 投标记录是否存在按项目名称判断，不因其输入/开标时间为空就当未投标。
-- R10：有商机并且所有商机都未匹配投标，按客户去重；任一商机已投标则不计入。
),
metric_results AS (
SELECT 10 AS sort_no,'R09'::text AS code,'待突破的战略客户数'::text AS metric_name,
NULL::text AS product_team,
 (NULL)::numeric AS amount_yi,(NULL)::numeric AS energy_gwh,(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE c.opportunity_count=0))::bigint AS item_count,
 (NULL)::numeric AS ratio_value,(NULL)::numeric AS days_value,('已实现；客户底表按关联商机数判定')::text AS status,
 '以客户表为底表，客户等级默认1（战略大客户）。通过客户.accountid＝商机.parentaccountid关联全部商机；关联商机数为0的客户按客户ID去重计数。 统计客户与商机关联现状；不按创建年份/审批状态/预测有无筛客户。等级0核心大客户不自动并入。值在“数量”列。'::text AS note,(jsonb_build_object('战略客户总数',COUNT(*),'有商机客户',COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE opportunity_count>0),'无商机客户',COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE opportunity_count=0),'客户明细',jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c))))::jsonb AS detail
FROM customer_coverage c
)
SELECT r.code AS "指标序号",r.metric_name AS "指标名称",r.product_team AS "产品团队",
p.start_date AS "期间开始",p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",r.item_count AS "数量",
r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
CASE WHEN r.status='查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' THEN
 CASE WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
        OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围' END ELSE r.status END AS "计算说明状态",
r.note AS "取值说明",r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results r CROSS JOIN context p ORDER BY r.sort_no,r.product_team NULLS LAST;;

C01.name: 处于 P0 阶段的战略客户未签单商机数及预测量
C01.definition: 客户等级为战略（默认客户表new_accountlevel=1）、商机new_processstage=11且statecode=0；通过订单明细未关联到实际订单的商机集合。按商机ID去重统计数量；预测量为该集合对应的预测金额及商机电量，按所选期间同商机同月最新预测汇总。

orders AS MATERIALIZED (

),
order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (

forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT m.new_oppmonthid::text AS forecast_id,m.new_opportunity_id::text AS opportunity_id,

FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb m CROSS JOIN context p
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(m.new_oppmonthid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(BTRIM(m.new_opportunity_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL
  AND m.new_accountdate::timestamp>=p.start_date AND m.new_accountdate::timestamp<p.end_exclusive
-- 月度事实：同商机同月按创建/修改时间取最新；不是全年每商机只留一个月份。
-- 商机预测金额直接用new_forecast_amt_rmb，不混用实际销售额。
-- 原穿透Excel/阶段TXT未另给审核状态范围，此查询不附加审核/业务状态过滤。
),
strategic_p0_unsigned AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.opportunity_id,o.product_type,a.account_id
FROM opportunity_rows o JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id=o.account_id
LEFT JOIN signed_orders s ON s.opportunity_id=o.opportunity_id CROSS JOIN context p
WHERE o.rn=1 AND o.process_stage='11' AND o.system_state='0'
 AND a.level_code=ANY(p.strategic_levels) AND COALESCE(s.order_count,0)=0
-- 有效商机按statecode=0，不额外添加审核状态或需求未确认筛选。
-- 先确定P0战略未签商机集合，不因商机缺月度预测记录而漏掉商机数量。
-- 订单关联由商机→订单明细.new_opportunity_id→订单.salesorderid判定，不使用合同确认枚举。
-- 数量为当前关联现状；预测金额及电量按所选预测期间。
),
strategic_p0_values AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(c.product_type)=1 THEN '全部' ELSE c.product_type END AS product_type,
 COUNT(DISTINCT c.opportunity_id) AS opportunity_count,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.opportunity_id)=0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(f.amount_yuan)/100000000::numeric END AS amount_yi,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.opportunity_id)=0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(f.amount_yuan/NULLIF(f.wh_price,0))/1000000000::numeric END AS energy_gwh,
 COUNT(f.forecast_id) AS forecast_rows,
 COUNT(DISTINCT c.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE f.forecast_id IS NULL) AS opportunities_without_period_forecast,
 COUNT(f.forecast_id) FILTER(WHERE f.amount_yuan IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
 COUNT(f.forecast_id) FILTER(WHERE f.amount_yuan IS NULL OR f.wh_price IS NULL OR f.wh_price=0) AS missing_energy_input_rows
FROM strategic_p0_unsigned c LEFT JOIN forecast_rows f ON f.opportunity_id=c.opportunity_id AND f.rn=1
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS((),(c.product_type))
),
metric_results AS (
SELECT 13 AS sort_no,'C01'::text AS code,'处于 P0 阶段的战略客户未签单商机数及预测量'::text AS metric_name,
NULL::text AS product_team,
 amount_yi,energy_gwh,opportunity_count::bigint AS item_count,NULL::numeric AS ratio_value,NULL::numeric AS days_value,
 '已实现；P0有效战略未签集合，数量与预测分开计算'::text AS status,
 'new_processstage=11，statecode=0，客户等级1，订单明细关联订单数为0；预测缺失不影响商机计数；预测按所选期间商机＋月份最新版本汇总。'::text AS note,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM strategic_p0_values x) AS detail
FROM strategic_p0_values WHERE product_type='全部'
)
SELECT r.code AS "指标序号",r.metric_name AS "指标名称",r.product_team AS "产品团队",
p.start_date AS "期间开始",p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",r.item_count AS "数量",
r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
CASE WHEN r.status='查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' THEN
 CASE WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
        OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围' END ELSE r.status END AS "计算说明状态",
r.note AS "取值说明",r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results r CROSS JOIN context p ORDER BY r.sort_no,r.product_team NULLS LAST;;

C07.name: 方案推动超平均周期 50% 的未签单商机
C07.definition: 筛选当前仍在方案推动（P2）、且尚未签单的商机。在途用时为测量日减 P2 进入日。动态平均周期引用 P2-01。 签单判定按本次确认：商机ID关联订单明细.new_opportunity_id，再由明细.salesorderid关联订单.salesorderid；至少1个去重订单ID为已签，0个为未签。不使用批量合同确认枚举。
C07.formula: 如未签单商机仍处于 P2，且实际在途用时严格大于 P2 动态平均周期的 1.5 倍，则判定“方案推动超期”原因成立。按电芯、PACK 匹配风险 2 的待签商机，统计受影响预测金额和电量。等于 1.5 倍时不触发。

-- 指标 C07 方案推动超平均周期 50% 的未签单商机：可直接调用 SQL（PostgreSQL 只读；业务表均为 ded_public）
-- 来源：穿透式分析_55种指标_查询_2025_C0及环节周期合并修订.sql 第 15 个指标分支；仅保留该指标依赖的 18 个 CTE，结果与整段执行时该指标的行一致。
-- 修改统计期间：只改 parameters 中的 start_date / end_exclusive（结束日不含）；无绑定参数。
WITH
parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive,
       CURRENT_TIMESTAMP::timestamp AS observed_at,
       ARRAY['1']::text[] AS strategic_levels,
       ARRAY['1','2']::text[] AS focus_levels,
       1000000::numeric AS target_power_units_per_gwh
-- 默认2025全年；结束日不含。仅修改这里，不需要填写绑定参数。
-- 战略客户默认等级1；重点跟踪默认1战略＋2重要。0核心/4BG不自动纳入。
-- 目标power暂沿用当前M0007单项的kWh换算，不用quantity冒充电量。
),
context AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT p.*,LEAST(observed_at,end_exclusive::timestamp) AS cutoff,
       make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1) AS year_start,
       make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer+1,1,1) AS next_year_start,
       GREATEST(0::numeric,LEAST(1::numeric,
        (LEAST(observed_at,end_exclusive::timestamp)::date-make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1))::numeric
        /(make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer+1,1,1)-make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1)))) AS time_progress
FROM parameters p
),
account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT a.accountid::text AS account_id,a.name::text AS account_name,
       a.new_accountlevel::text AS level_code,
       a.new_sapdate::timestamp AS sap_created_at,a.new_sapsubmitdate::timestamp AS sap_submitted_at,
       a.new_approved_time_facreview::timestamp AS account_factory_approved_at,
       a.new_submit_time_facreview::timestamp AS account_factory_submitted_at,
       a.new_sinosurestartdate::timestamp AS account_sinosure_start,
       a.new_sinosureenddate::timestamp AS account_sinosure_end,
       a.new_submit_time_accredit::timestamp AS account_credit_submitted_at,
       a.new_approvaltime_accredit::timestamp AS account_credit_approved_at,
       a.new_cdastartdate::timestamp AS account_cda_start,
       a.new_cdaenddate::timestamp AS account_cda_end,
       a.new_cda_submittime::timestamp AS account_cda_submitted_at,
       a.new_cda_approved_time::timestamp AS account_cda_approved_at,
       a.new_approvalstatus_facreview::text AS account_factory_approval_status,
       a.new_sapcode::text AS sap_code,a.new_issap::text AS sap_registered,
       a.new_issapnew::text AS sap_registration_kind,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY a.accountid ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST,a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb a WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(a.accountid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT account_id,account_name,level_code,sap_created_at,sap_submitted_at,account_factory_approved_at,account_factory_submitted_at,account_sinosure_start,account_sinosure_end,account_credit_submitted_at,account_credit_approved_at,account_cda_start,account_cda_end,account_cda_submitted_at,account_cda_approved_at,account_factory_approval_status,sap_code,sap_registered,sap_registration_kind FROM account_rows WHERE rn=1
),
opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.opportunityid::text AS opportunity_id,o.parentaccountid::text AS account_id,
       o.name::text AS project_name,o.ownerid::text AS owner_id,
       CASE WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯'
            WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS product_type,
       o.new_isqualifiedsuppliers::text AS supplier_flag,
       o.new_istechnologyagreement::text AS technical_flag,
       o.new_iswarranty::text AS warranty_flag,
       o.new_processstage::text AS process_stage,o.statecode::text AS system_state,o.new_demandinput::text AS demand_status,
       o.createdon::timestamp AS created_at,o.new_stage1enddate::timestamp AS s1,
       o.new_stage2enddate::timestamp AS s2,o.new_stage3enddate::timestamp AS s3,
       o.new_stage4enddate::timestamp AS s4,o.new_stage5enddate::timestamp AS s5,
       o.new_cdastartdate::timestamp AS new_cdastartdate,
       o.new_cdaenddate::timestamp AS new_cdaenddate,
       o.new_approved_time_acneed::timestamp AS new_approved_time_acneed,
       o.new_submit_time_acneed::timestamp AS new_submit_time_acneed,
       o.new_issalesforecast_date::timestamp AS new_issalesforecast_date,
       o.new_approved_time_projectassess::timestamp AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
       o.new_submit_time_projectassess::timestamp AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
       o.new_sampletestpass_time::timestamp AS new_sampletestpass_time,
       o.new_sampletime::timestamp AS new_sampletime,
       o.new_technicalsigningdate::timestamp AS new_technicalsigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_techcon::timestamp AS new_submit_time_techcon,
       o.new_warrantysigningdate::timestamp AS new_warrantysigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_qsl::timestamp AS new_submit_time_qsl,
       o.new_isneedcda::text AS new_isneedcda,
       o.new_approvalstatus_acneed::text AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
       o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess::text AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
       o.new_approvalstatus_techcon::text AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
       o.new_approvalstatus_qsl::text AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
       o.new_sampletestresult::text AS new_sampletestresult,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY o.opportunityid ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST,o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb o
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(o.opportunityid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.opportunity_id,o.account_id,o.project_name,o.owner_id,o.product_type,o.process_stage,o.demand_status,
       o.created_at,o.s1,o.s2,o.s3,o.s4,o.s5,a.account_name,a.level_code,
       o.new_cdastartdate,
       o.new_cdaenddate,
       o.new_approved_time_acneed,
       o.new_submit_time_acneed,
       o.new_issalesforecast_date,
       o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
       o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
       o.new_sampletestpass_time,
       o.new_sampletime,
       o.new_technicalsigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_techcon,
       o.new_warrantysigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_qsl,
       o.new_isneedcda,
       o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
       o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
       o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
       o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
       o.new_sampletestresult,a.sap_created_at,a.sap_submitted_at,a.sap_code,a.account_factory_approved_at,a.account_factory_submitted_at,a.account_sinosure_start,a.account_sinosure_end,a.account_credit_submitted_at,a.account_credit_approved_at,a.account_cda_start,a.account_cda_end,a.account_cda_submitted_at,a.account_cda_approved_at,a.account_factory_approval_status
FROM opportunity_rows o LEFT JOIN accounts a USING(account_id) CROSS JOIN context p
WHERE o.rn=1 AND (o.created_at IS NULL OR o.created_at<=p.cutoff)
),
orders AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT salesorderid::text AS order_id
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(salesorderid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
-- 签单严格按“有关联订单”确认：不使用订单头opportunityid，也不使用合同确认枚举。
-- 未额外限定审批、取消状态或订单日期；本查询统计的是关联关系现状，不是历史签单快照。
),
order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT l.new_opportunity_id::text AS opportunity_id,l.salesorderid::text AS order_id
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb l
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(l.new_opportunity_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(BTRIM(l.salesorderid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT l.opportunity_id,COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
FROM order_line_links l JOIN orders o USING(order_id) GROUP BY l.opportunity_id
),
bid_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT b.project_name::text AS project_name,b.seq_no::text AS bid_id,b.seq_no AS bid_seq,b.remark::text AS remark,
       NULLIF(BTRIM(b.input_time::text),'')::timestamp AS input_at,
       NULLIF(BTRIM(b.bid_open_time::text),'')::timestamp AS open_at,
       NULLIF(BTRIM(b.winner_announce_time::text),'')::timestamp AS result_at
FROM ded_public.p_fm_bid_project_info b
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(b.project_name::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
bid_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT project_name,bid_id,remark,input_at,result_at FROM (
 SELECT b.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY project_name ORDER BY input_at DESC NULLS LAST,bid_seq DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
 FROM bid_rows b CROSS JOIN context p WHERE b.input_at IS NOT NULL AND b.input_at<=p.cutoff
) r WHERE rn=1
),
opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.*,COALESCE(s.order_count,0) AS order_count,COALESCE(s.order_count,0)>0 AS signed,
       b.project_name IS NOT NULL AS entered_bid,
       b.project_name IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(b.remark,'') NOT LIKE '%弃标%'
          AND (b.result_at IS NULL OR b.result_at>p.cutoff) AS bidding,
       b.bid_id,b.input_at,b.result_at
FROM opportunities o LEFT JOIN signed_orders s USING(opportunity_id)
LEFT JOIN bid_latest b ON b.project_name=o.project_name CROSS JOIN context p
),
forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT m.new_oppmonthid::text AS forecast_id,m.new_opportunity_id::text AS opportunity_id,
       m.new_accountdate::timestamp AS forecast_month,m.new_forecast_amt_rmb::numeric AS amount_yuan,
       m.new_whprice::numeric AS wh_price,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id,date_trunc('month',m.new_accountdate::timestamp)
        ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST,m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST,m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb m CROSS JOIN context p
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(m.new_oppmonthid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(BTRIM(m.new_opportunity_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL
  AND m.new_accountdate::timestamp>=p.start_date AND m.new_accountdate::timestamp<p.end_exclusive
-- 月度事实：同商机同月按创建/修改时间取最新；不是全年每商机只留一个月份。
-- 商机预测金额直接用new_forecast_amt_rmb，不混用实际销售额。
-- 原穿透Excel/阶段TXT未另给审核状态范围，此查询不附加审核/业务状态过滤。
),
forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT f.forecast_id,f.forecast_month,o.*,
       f.amount_yuan/100000000::numeric AS amount_yi,
       f.amount_yuan/NULLIF(f.wh_price,0)/1000000000::numeric AS energy_gwh
FROM forecast_rows f JOIN opportunity_flags o USING(opportunity_id) WHERE f.rn=1
-- new_whprice沿用现有商机指标的元/Wh口径；金额÷单价得到Wh，再÷10^9转GWh。
),
opportunity_forecast AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT opportunity_id,COUNT(*) AS forecast_rows,SUM(amount_yi) AS amount_yi,SUM(energy_gwh) AS energy_gwh,
       COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
       COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
FROM forecast_facts GROUP BY opportunity_id
),
stage_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.*,v.stage_code,v.started_at,v.finished_at,
       (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (LEAST(COALESCE(v.finished_at,p.cutoff),p.cutoff)-v.started_at))/86400::numeric) AS elapsed_days,
       v.started_at>=p.start_date AND v.started_at<p.end_exclusive AS in_window,
       v.finished_at IS NULL OR v.finished_at>p.cutoff AS inflight,
       v.started_at IS NULL OR (v.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND v.finished_at<v.started_at) AS invalid_dates
FROM opportunity_flags o CROSS JOIN context p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
 ('P0',o.created_at,o.s1),('P1',o.s1,o.s2),('P2',o.s2,o.s3),('P3',o.s3,o.s4),('P4',o.s4,o.s5)
) v(stage_code,started_at,finished_at)
WHERE v.started_at IS NOT NULL AND v.started_at<=p.cutoff
-- 不是“当前阶段枚举＝某值”才入均值；已进入该阶段且已完成/仍在途的样本都参与。
-- 日期逆序剔除并计数；在途截至所选期末与观察日中的较早者。
),
stage_means AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT stage_code,product_type,AVG(elapsed_days) FILTER(WHERE NOT invalid_dates) AS mean_days,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT invalid_dates) AS sample_count,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE invalid_dates) AS invalid_count,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE inflight AND NOT invalid_dates) AS inflight_count
FROM stage_facts WHERE in_window GROUP BY stage_code,product_type
),
stage_overdue AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT f.*,m.mean_days,ofc.amount_yi,ofc.energy_gwh,
       f.elapsed_days>1.5*m.mean_days AS overdue
FROM stage_facts f JOIN stage_means m USING(stage_code,product_type)
LEFT JOIN opportunity_forecast ofc USING(opportunity_id) WHERE NOT f.invalid_dates
),
metric_results AS (
SELECT 15 AS sort_no,'C07'::text AS code,'方案推动超平均周期 50% 的未签单商机'::text AS metric_name,
NULL::text AS product_team,
(SUM(amount_yi))::numeric AS amount_yi,(SUM(energy_gwh))::numeric AS energy_gwh,(COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id))::bigint AS item_count,
(NULL)::numeric AS ratio_value,(NULL)::numeric AS days_value,'查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'::text AS status,
'仍在P2、未签、在途天数严格大于同产品P2均值1.5倍；均值含窗口内已完成及在途。'::text AS note,(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('商机ID',opportunity_id,'产品',product_type,'在途天数',elapsed_days,'均值',mean_days,'预测金额亿元',amount_yi,'预测电量GWh',energy_gwh)))::jsonb AS detail
FROM stage_overdue f WHERE stage_code='P2' AND process_stage='13' AND inflight AND NOT signed AND overdue
)
SELECT r.code AS "指标序号",r.metric_name AS "指标名称",r.product_team AS "产品团队",
p.start_date AS "期间开始",p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",r.item_count AS "数量",
r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
CASE WHEN r.status='查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' THEN
 CASE WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
        OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围' END ELSE r.status END AS "计算说明状态",
r.note AS "取值说明",r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results r CROSS JOIN context p ORDER BY r.sort_no,r.product_team NULLS LAST;;

C03.name: 产品部年度销售目标
C03.definition: 以产品团队为维度，按商机＋年度取最新目标版本，展开并汇总全年new_month1～12金额和new_month1_power～12_power电量。同一团队一行。 仅列出实际有目标事实记录的团队。
C03.formula: 年度目标作为产品部差距判定的比较基准。与 C04 的实际销售使用同年度、产品部及统计范围，按 C05 判定该产品部的销售缺口是否成立。
C03.caliber: 按产品团队分解年度目标；目标先按商机＋年取最新版本，金额使用月金额，电量使用月power。团队空值行过滤。
C03.attributes:
LE01-A0486 商机管理.负责人（ownerid，空 0%）
LE06-A0016 销售目标管理.负责人（ownerid，空 0%）
LE06-A0022 销售目标管理.负责团队（owningteam，空 100%）
LE06-A0041 销售目标管理.1月金额（new_month1，空 0%）
LE06-A0072 销售目标管理.1月电量（new_month1_power，空 0%）
C03.physicalFields: 目标.owningteam/ownerid；团队/成员关系；目标各月金额与power
C03.dashboardSql: 按产品团队分解年度目标；目标先按商机＋年取最新版本，金额使用月金额，电量使用月power。团队空值行过滤。
C03.notes: C0专项增加来源记录数、非空计数与团队归属路径诊断。C03仅目标有记录团队，C04仅实绩有记录团队，C05明确未查到哪一侧；不把未出现的团队误报为核心字段全空，不强行补0。
C03.sqlStatus: 按结果动态判定（见 SQL 中 status 的 CASE）
C03.role: 根因判定 / 行动跟踪
C03.ctes: parameters → context → opportunity_rows → order_line_links → product_types → teams → team_members → owner_teams → target_rows → target_facts → shipment_headers → product_codes → order_teams → shipment_rows → shipment_facts → target_teams → actual_teams → team_gaps → c0_owner_team_sizes → c0_target_assignment → c0_team_assignment_audit
C03.sql:
-- 指标 C03 产品部年度销售目标：可直接调用 SQL（PostgreSQL 只读；业务表均为 ded_public）
-- 来源：穿透式分析_55种指标_查询_2025_C0及环节周期合并修订.sql 第 16 个指标分支；仅保留该指标依赖的 21 个 CTE，结果与整段执行时该指标的行一致。
-- 修改统计期间：只改 parameters 中的 start_date / end_exclusive（结束日不含）；无绑定参数。
WITH
parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive,
       CURRENT_TIMESTAMP::timestamp AS observed_at,
       ARRAY['1']::text[] AS strategic_levels,
       ARRAY['1','2']::text[] AS focus_levels,
       1000000::numeric AS target_power_units_per_gwh
-- 默认2025全年；结束日不含。仅修改这里，不需要填写绑定参数。
-- 战略客户默认等级1；重点跟踪默认1战略＋2重要。0核心/4BG不自动纳入。
-- 目标power暂沿用当前M0007单项的kWh换算，不用quantity冒充电量。
),
context AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT p.*,LEAST(observed_at,end_exclusive::timestamp) AS cutoff,
       make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1) AS year_start,
       make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer+1,1,1) AS next_year_start,
       GREATEST(0::numeric,LEAST(1::numeric,
        (LEAST(observed_at,end_exclusive::timestamp)::date-make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1))::numeric
        /(make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer+1,1,1)-make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1)))) AS time_progress
FROM parameters p
),
opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.opportunityid::text AS opportunity_id,o.parentaccountid::text AS account_id,
       o.name::text AS project_name,o.ownerid::text AS owner_id,
       CASE WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯'
            WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS product_type,
       o.new_isqualifiedsuppliers::text AS supplier_flag,
       o.new_istechnologyagreement::text AS technical_flag,
       o.new_iswarranty::text AS warranty_flag,
       o.new_processstage::text AS process_stage,o.statecode::text AS system_state,o.new_demandinput::text AS demand_status,
       o.createdon::timestamp AS created_at,o.new_stage1enddate::timestamp AS s1,
       o.new_stage2enddate::timestamp AS s2,o.new_stage3enddate::timestamp AS s3,
       o.new_stage4enddate::timestamp AS s4,o.new_stage5enddate::timestamp AS s5,
       o.new_cdastartdate::timestamp AS new_cdastartdate,
       o.new_cdaenddate::timestamp AS new_cdaenddate,
       o.new_approved_time_acneed::timestamp AS new_approved_time_acneed,
       o.new_submit_time_acneed::timestamp AS new_submit_time_acneed,
       o.new_issalesforecast_date::timestamp AS new_issalesforecast_date,
       o.new_approved_time_projectassess::timestamp AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
       o.new_submit_time_projectassess::timestamp AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
       o.new_sampletestpass_time::timestamp AS new_sampletestpass_time,
       o.new_sampletime::timestamp AS new_sampletime,
       o.new_technicalsigningdate::timestamp AS new_technicalsigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_techcon::timestamp AS new_submit_time_techcon,
       o.new_warrantysigningdate::timestamp AS new_warrantysigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_qsl::timestamp AS new_submit_time_qsl,
       o.new_isneedcda::text AS new_isneedcda,
       o.new_approvalstatus_acneed::text AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
       o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess::text AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
       o.new_approvalstatus_techcon::text AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
       o.new_approvalstatus_qsl::text AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
       o.new_sampletestresult::text AS new_sampletestresult,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY o.opportunityid ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST,o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb o
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(o.opportunityid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT l.new_opportunity_id::text AS opportunity_id,l.salesorderid::text AS order_id
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb l
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(l.new_opportunity_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(BTRIM(l.salesorderid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT new_product_typeid::text AS product_type_id,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT new_accproducttype::text)=1 THEN MIN(new_accproducttype::text) END AS type_code
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb GROUP BY new_product_typeid::text
),
teams AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT teamid::text AS team_id,MAX(name::text) AS team_name
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb GROUP BY teamid::text
),
team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT tm.systemuserid::text AS owner_id,t.name::text AS team_name
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb tm
JOIN (SELECT team_id,team_name AS name FROM teams) t ON t.team_id=tm.teamid::text
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(t.name::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT owner_id,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name)=1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
FROM team_members GROUP BY owner_id
-- 多团队负责人不将一笔金额重复分摊到全部团队；保留未分配并在明细显示。
),
target_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT t.new_targetid::text AS target_id,t.new_opportunity_id::text AS opportunity_id,
       t.new_year::integer AS year_no,t.new_account_id::text AS account_id,t.ownerid::text AS owner_id,t.owningteam::text AS owning_team_id,
       t.new_producttype_id::text AS product_type_id,
       t.new_month1,t.new_month2,t.new_month3,t.new_month4,t.new_month5,t.new_month6,
       t.new_month7,t.new_month8,t.new_month9,t.new_month10,t.new_month11,t.new_month12,
       t.new_month1_power,t.new_month2_power,t.new_month3_power,t.new_month4_power,t.new_month5_power,t.new_month6_power,
       t.new_month7_power,t.new_month8_power,t.new_month9_power,t.new_month10_power,t.new_month11_power,t.new_month12_power,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(t.new_opportunity_id::text),''),t.new_targetid::text),t.new_year
        ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST,t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb t CROSS JOIN context p
WHERE t.new_year::integer=EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date)::integer AND t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
-- 目标先按商机＋年取最新。空商机ID以目标ID独立保留，避免全部空ID挤成一条。
),
target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT t.target_id,t.account_id,
       CASE WHEN pt.type_code IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN pt.type_code IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他' END AS product_type,COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(owned.team_name),''),ot.team_name) AS team_name,
       v.amount_yuan::numeric/100000000::numeric AS amount_yi,
       v.power_value::numeric/p.target_power_units_per_gwh AS energy_gwh
FROM target_rows t CROSS JOIN context p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (1,t.new_month1,t.new_month1_power),
(2,t.new_month2,t.new_month2_power),
(3,t.new_month3,t.new_month3_power),
(4,t.new_month4,t.new_month4_power),
(5,t.new_month5,t.new_month5_power),
(6,t.new_month6,t.new_month6_power),
(7,t.new_month7,t.new_month7_power),
(8,t.new_month8,t.new_month8_power),
(9,t.new_month9,t.new_month9_power),
(10,t.new_month10,t.new_month10_power),
(11,t.new_month11,t.new_month11_power),
(12,t.new_month12,t.new_month12_power)) v(month_no,amount_yuan,power_value)
LEFT JOIN product_types pt USING(product_type_id) LEFT JOIN owner_teams ot USING(owner_id)
LEFT JOIN teams owned ON owned.team_id=t.owning_team_id
WHERE t.rn=1 AND make_date(t.year_no,v.month_no,1)>=p.year_start
  AND make_date(t.year_no,v.month_no,1)<p.next_year_start
-- B01/C03为年度目标，即使以后把起止改为月，也不把年度目标误缩为单月目标。
),
shipment_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT new_ord_shipmentid::text AS shipment_id,
 new_shipping2_date::timestamp AS shipped_at,statecode
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb s CROSS JOIN context p
WHERE s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp>=p.start_date
 AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp<LEAST(p.end_exclusive::timestamp,p.observed_at)
),
product_codes AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT productnumber::text AS product_code,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT new_system_energy)=1 THEN MAX(new_system_energy)::numeric END AS energy_kwh
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(productnumber::text),'') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY productnumber::text
),
order_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT l.order_id,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name)=1
       AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.opportunity_id)=COUNT(DISTINCT l.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE t.team_name IS NOT NULL)
      THEN MIN(t.team_name) END AS team_name
FROM order_line_links l
LEFT JOIN opportunity_rows o ON o.opportunity_id=l.opportunity_id AND o.rn=1
LEFT JOIN owner_teams t ON t.owner_id=o.owner_id
GROUP BY l.order_id
-- 团队查找不以商机创建年份截断；发货事实仍按所选发货期间筛选。
-- 关联ID未匹配商机、负责人多团队或一单多团队时均保留未分配，不把整单强行归到已知团队。
),
shipment_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT i.new_ord_shipmentitemid::text AS line_id,i.new_ord_shipment_id::text AS shipment_id,
 i.new_ord_salesorder_id::text AS order_id,i.new_productcode::text AS product_code,
 i.new_qty::numeric AS qty,i.new_amount_base::numeric/100000000::numeric AS amount_yi,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY i.new_ord_shipmentitemid ORDER BY i.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST,i.createdon DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb i
WHERE i.new_ord_shipmentitemid IS NOT NULL AND i.new_qty>0
),
shipment_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT i.line_id,t.team_name,i.amount_yi,i.qty*pc.energy_kwh/1000000::numeric AS energy_gwh
FROM shipment_rows i JOIN shipment_headers s USING(shipment_id)
LEFT JOIN product_codes pc USING(product_code) LEFT JOIN order_teams t USING(order_id)
WHERE i.rn=1 AND s.statecode=0
),
target_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT team_name,SUM(amount_yi) AS target_amount,SUM(energy_gwh) AS target_energy,
 COUNT(DISTINCT target_id) AS target_record_count,COUNT(*) AS target_month_rows,
 COUNT(amount_yi) AS target_amount_nonnull_rows,COUNT(energy_gwh) AS target_energy_nonnull_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE amount_yi IS NULL) AS target_missing_amount_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE energy_gwh IS NULL) AS target_missing_energy_rows
FROM target_facts GROUP BY team_name
),
actual_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT team_name,SUM(amount_yi) AS actual_amount,SUM(energy_gwh) AS actual_energy,
 COUNT(DISTINCT line_id) AS actual_record_count,COUNT(amount_yi) AS actual_amount_nonnull_rows,
 COUNT(energy_gwh) AS actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
FROM shipment_facts GROUP BY team_name
),
team_gaps AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT COALESCE(v.team_name,'未能唯一分配团队') AS team_name,
 SUM(target_amount) AS target_amount,SUM(actual_amount) AS actual_amount,
 SUM(actual_amount)-SUM(target_amount) AS gap_amount,
 SUM(target_energy) AS target_energy,SUM(actual_energy) AS actual_energy,
 SUM(actual_energy)-SUM(target_energy) AS gap_energy,
 SUM(target_record_count)::bigint AS target_record_count,SUM(actual_record_count)::bigint AS actual_record_count,
 SUM(target_amount_nonnull_rows)::bigint AS target_amount_nonnull_rows,
 SUM(target_energy_nonnull_rows)::bigint AS target_energy_nonnull_rows,
 SUM(actual_amount_nonnull_rows)::bigint AS actual_amount_nonnull_rows,
 SUM(actual_energy_nonnull_rows)::bigint AS actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
 SUM(target_missing_amount_rows)::bigint AS target_missing_amount_rows,
 SUM(target_missing_energy_rows)::bigint AS target_missing_energy_rows,
 SUM(missing_amount_rows)::bigint AS missing_amount_rows,SUM(missing_energy_rows)::bigint AS missing_energy_rows,
 BOOL_OR(v.team_name IS NULL) AS unassigned_team
FROM (
 SELECT team_name,target_amount,target_energy,NULL::numeric AS actual_amount,NULL::numeric AS actual_energy,
 target_record_count,0::bigint AS actual_record_count,target_amount_nonnull_rows,target_energy_nonnull_rows,
 0::bigint AS actual_amount_nonnull_rows,0::bigint AS actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
 target_missing_amount_rows,target_missing_energy_rows,0::bigint AS missing_amount_rows,0::bigint AS missing_energy_rows
 FROM target_teams
 UNION ALL
 SELECT team_name,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,actual_amount,actual_energy,
 0::bigint,actual_record_count,0::bigint,0::bigint,actual_amount_nonnull_rows,actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
 0::bigint,0::bigint,missing_amount_rows,missing_energy_rows FROM actual_teams
) v GROUP BY v.team_name
-- 记录数0表示该路径下无该团队记录；有记录但非空计数0才表示核心字段全空。
-- C03仅展示目标侧有记录团队，C04仅展示实绩侧有记录团队；C05保留两侧对照解释。
),
c0_owner_team_sizes AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT owner_id,COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) AS candidate_team_count
FROM team_members GROUP BY owner_id
),
c0_target_assignment AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT t.target_id,t.opportunity_id,
 COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(owned.team_name),''),ot.team_name) AS current_target_team,
 linked.team_name AS team_via_linked_opportunity,
 sizes.candidate_team_count AS target_owner_team_candidates,
 linked_sizes.candidate_team_count AS opportunity_owner_team_candidates,
 (COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(owned.team_name),''),ot.team_name) IS DISTINCT FROM linked.team_name)
 AND linked.team_name IS NOT NULL AS team_paths_differ
FROM target_rows t LEFT JOIN teams owned ON owned.team_id=t.owning_team_id
LEFT JOIN owner_teams ot ON ot.owner_id=t.owner_id
LEFT JOIN c0_owner_team_sizes sizes ON sizes.owner_id=t.owner_id
LEFT JOIN opportunity_rows o ON o.opportunity_id=t.opportunity_id AND o.rn=1
LEFT JOIN owner_teams linked ON linked.owner_id=o.owner_id
LEFT JOIN c0_owner_team_sizes linked_sizes ON linked_sizes.owner_id=o.owner_id
WHERE t.rn=1
),
c0_team_assignment_audit AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM c0_target_assignment WHERE team_paths_differ) AS target_opportunity_team_mismatch_records,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM target_facts WHERE team_name IS NULL) AS unassigned_target_month_rows,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipment_facts WHERE team_name IS NULL) AS unassigned_shipment_rows,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM c0_owner_team_sizes WHERE candidate_team_count>1) AS owners_with_multiple_teams,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (
   SELECT * FROM c0_target_assignment WHERE team_paths_differ ORDER BY target_id LIMIT 50
 ) x) AS target_assignment_difference_examples_limit50
-- 两条团队归属路径对照，不擅自用模糊团队名称或MAX/MIN选一个团队代替。
),
metric_results AS (
SELECT 16 AS sort_no,'C03'::text AS code,'产品部年度销售目标'::text AS metric_name,
 t.team_name::text AS product_team,t.target_amount::numeric AS amount_yi,t.target_energy::numeric AS energy_gwh,
 NULL::bigint AS item_count,NULL::numeric AS ratio_value,NULL::numeric AS days_value,
 (CASE WHEN target_amount_nonnull_rows=0 AND target_energy_nonnull_rows=0 THEN '有目标记录，但核心计算字段全空' WHEN target_missing_amount_rows>0 OR target_missing_energy_rows>0 THEN '目标字段部分缺失；当前为已知值合计' ELSE '已有目标记录并可计算' END)::text AS status,
 '按团队分别保留来源记录计数；记录不存在与核心字段全空分别说明。目标owningteam/owner与实绩商机owner的归属对照在明细；不强行补0，不凭名称归并产品部。'::text AS note,
 to_jsonb(t)||jsonb_build_object('团队归属核对',(SELECT to_jsonb(q) FROM c0_team_assignment_audit q)) AS detail
FROM team_gaps t WHERE target_record_count>0
)
SELECT r.code AS "指标序号",r.metric_name AS "指标名称",r.product_team AS "产品团队",
p.start_date AS "期间开始",p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",r.item_count AS "数量",
r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
CASE WHEN r.status='查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' THEN
 CASE WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
        OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围' END ELSE r.status END AS "计算说明状态",
r.note AS "取值说明",r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results r CROSS JOIN context p ORDER BY r.sort_no,r.product_team NULLS LAST;;

C04.name: 产品部累计实际销售额／电量
C04.definition: 以产品团队为维度，汇总所选年度/期间截至观察日的实际销售额和实际销售电量。团队与C03保持同一名称范围，同一团队一行。 仅列出实际有实绩事实记录的团队。
C04.formula: 累计实际销售作为产品部差距判定的实绩依据。与 C03 的年度目标使用同年度、产品部及统计范围，按 C05 判定该产品部的销售缺口是否成立。
C04.caliber: 实际金额＝发货明细.new_amount_base÷10^8。当前实际电量单项按明细.new_productcode关联产品.productnumber，SUM(交货数量×new_system_energy)÷10^6；团队由订单明细关联商机后解析。
C04.attributes:
LE06-A0053 销售目标管理.项目号（new_opportunity_id，空 0%）
LE08-A0025 订单产品.项目（new_opportunity_id，空 53.23%）
LE16-A0017 发货单.实际发货日期（new_shipping2_date，空 0%）
LE17-A0008 发货单明细.交货数量（new_qty，空 0%）
LE17-A0012 发货单明细.物料编码（new_productcode，空 0%）
LE17-A0022 发货单明细.总金额(基础货币)（new_amount_base，空 0%）
LE18-A0031 产品物料.系统能量kWh（new_system_energy，空 38.81%）
LE18-A0095 产品物料.物料编码（productnumber，空 0%）
C04.dashboardSql: 实际金额＝发货明细.new_amount_base÷10^8。当前实际电量单项按明细.new_productcode关联产品.productnumber，SUM(交货数量×new_system_energy)÷10^6；团队由订单明细关联商机后解析。
C04.notes: C0专项增加来源记录数、非空计数与团队归属路径诊断。C03仅目标有记录团队，C04仅实绩有记录团队，C05明确未查到哪一侧；不把未出现的团队误报为核心字段全空，不强行补0。 团队维度查找不再额外按商机创建年份截断，实际销售事实仍按发货期间筛选；同一订单有归属不明商机时不强行分给已知团队。 引用ID未匹配到商机的明细也视为团队归属不明。
C04.sqlStatus: 按结果动态判定（见 SQL 中 status 的 CASE）
C04.role: 根因判定 / 行动跟踪
C04.ctes: parameters → context → opportunity_rows → order_line_links → product_types → teams → team_members → owner_teams → target_rows → target_facts → shipment_headers → product_codes → order_teams → shipment_rows → shipment_facts → target_teams → actual_teams → team_gaps → c0_owner_team_sizes → c0_target_assignment → c0_team_assignment_audit
C04.sql:
-- 指标 C04 产品部累计实际销售额／电量：可直接调用 SQL（PostgreSQL 只读；业务表均为 ded_public）
-- 来源：穿透式分析_55种指标_查询_2025_C0及环节周期合并修订.sql 第 17 个指标分支；仅保留该指标依赖的 21 个 CTE，结果与整段执行时该指标的行一致。
-- 修改统计期间：只改 parameters 中的 start_date / end_exclusive（结束日不含）；无绑定参数。
WITH
parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive,
       CURRENT_TIMESTAMP::timestamp AS observed_at,
       ARRAY['1']::text[] AS strategic_levels,
       ARRAY['1','2']::text[] AS focus_levels,
       1000000::numeric AS target_power_units_per_gwh
-- 默认2025全年；结束日不含。仅修改这里，不需要填写绑定参数。
-- 战略客户默认等级1；重点跟踪默认1战略＋2重要。0核心/4BG不自动纳入。
-- 目标power暂沿用当前M0007单项的kWh换算，不用quantity冒充电量。
),
context AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT p.*,LEAST(observed_at,end_exclusive::timestamp) AS cutoff,
       make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1) AS year_start,
       make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer+1,1,1) AS next_year_start,
       GREATEST(0::numeric,LEAST(1::numeric,
        (LEAST(observed_at,end_exclusive::timestamp)::date-make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1))::numeric
        /(make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer+1,1,1)-make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1)))) AS time_progress
FROM parameters p
),
opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.opportunityid::text AS opportunity_id,o.parentaccountid::text AS account_id,
       o.name::text AS project_name,o.ownerid::text AS owner_id,
       CASE WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯'
            WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS product_type,
       o.new_isqualifiedsuppliers::text AS supplier_flag,
       o.new_istechnologyagreement::text AS technical_flag,
       o.new_iswarranty::text AS warranty_flag,
       o.new_processstage::text AS process_stage,o.statecode::text AS system_state,o.new_demandinput::text AS demand_status,
       o.createdon::timestamp AS created_at,o.new_stage1enddate::timestamp AS s1,
       o.new_stage2enddate::timestamp AS s2,o.new_stage3enddate::timestamp AS s3,
       o.new_stage4enddate::timestamp AS s4,o.new_stage5enddate::timestamp AS s5,
       o.new_cdastartdate::timestamp AS new_cdastartdate,
       o.new_cdaenddate::timestamp AS new_cdaenddate,
       o.new_approved_time_acneed::timestamp AS new_approved_time_acneed,
       o.new_submit_time_acneed::timestamp AS new_submit_time_acneed,
       o.new_issalesforecast_date::timestamp AS new_issalesforecast_date,
       o.new_approved_time_projectassess::timestamp AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
       o.new_submit_time_projectassess::timestamp AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
       o.new_sampletestpass_time::timestamp AS new_sampletestpass_time,
       o.new_sampletime::timestamp AS new_sampletime,
       o.new_technicalsigningdate::timestamp AS new_technicalsigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_techcon::timestamp AS new_submit_time_techcon,
       o.new_warrantysigningdate::timestamp AS new_warrantysigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_qsl::timestamp AS new_submit_time_qsl,
       o.new_isneedcda::text AS new_isneedcda,
       o.new_approvalstatus_acneed::text AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
       o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess::text AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
       o.new_approvalstatus_techcon::text AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
       o.new_approvalstatus_qsl::text AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
       o.new_sampletestresult::text AS new_sampletestresult,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY o.opportunityid ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST,o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb o
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(o.opportunityid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT l.new_opportunity_id::text AS opportunity_id,l.salesorderid::text AS order_id
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb l
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(l.new_opportunity_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(BTRIM(l.salesorderid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT new_product_typeid::text AS product_type_id,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT new_accproducttype::text)=1 THEN MIN(new_accproducttype::text) END AS type_code
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb GROUP BY new_product_typeid::text
),
teams AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT teamid::text AS team_id,MAX(name::text) AS team_name
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb GROUP BY teamid::text
),
team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT tm.systemuserid::text AS owner_id,t.name::text AS team_name
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb tm
JOIN (SELECT team_id,team_name AS name FROM teams) t ON t.team_id=tm.teamid::text
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(t.name::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT owner_id,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name)=1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
FROM team_members GROUP BY owner_id
-- 多团队负责人不将一笔金额重复分摊到全部团队；保留未分配并在明细显示。
),
target_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT t.new_targetid::text AS target_id,t.new_opportunity_id::text AS opportunity_id,
       t.new_year::integer AS year_no,t.new_account_id::text AS account_id,t.ownerid::text AS owner_id,t.owningteam::text AS owning_team_id,
       t.new_producttype_id::text AS product_type_id,
       t.new_month1,t.new_month2,t.new_month3,t.new_month4,t.new_month5,t.new_month6,
       t.new_month7,t.new_month8,t.new_month9,t.new_month10,t.new_month11,t.new_month12,
       t.new_month1_power,t.new_month2_power,t.new_month3_power,t.new_month4_power,t.new_month5_power,t.new_month6_power,
       t.new_month7_power,t.new_month8_power,t.new_month9_power,t.new_month10_power,t.new_month11_power,t.new_month12_power,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(t.new_opportunity_id::text),''),t.new_targetid::text),t.new_year
        ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST,t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb t CROSS JOIN context p
WHERE t.new_year::integer=EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date)::integer AND t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
-- 目标先按商机＋年取最新。空商机ID以目标ID独立保留，避免全部空ID挤成一条。
),
target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT t.target_id,t.account_id,
       CASE WHEN pt.type_code IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN pt.type_code IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他' END AS product_type,COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(owned.team_name),''),ot.team_name) AS team_name,
       v.amount_yuan::numeric/100000000::numeric AS amount_yi,
       v.power_value::numeric/p.target_power_units_per_gwh AS energy_gwh
FROM target_rows t CROSS JOIN context p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (1,t.new_month1,t.new_month1_power),
(2,t.new_month2,t.new_month2_power),
(3,t.new_month3,t.new_month3_power),
(4,t.new_month4,t.new_month4_power),
(5,t.new_month5,t.new_month5_power),
(6,t.new_month6,t.new_month6_power),
(7,t.new_month7,t.new_month7_power),
(8,t.new_month8,t.new_month8_power),
(9,t.new_month9,t.new_month9_power),
(10,t.new_month10,t.new_month10_power),
(11,t.new_month11,t.new_month11_power),
(12,t.new_month12,t.new_month12_power)) v(month_no,amount_yuan,power_value)
LEFT JOIN product_types pt USING(product_type_id) LEFT JOIN owner_teams ot USING(owner_id)
LEFT JOIN teams owned ON owned.team_id=t.owning_team_id
WHERE t.rn=1 AND make_date(t.year_no,v.month_no,1)>=p.year_start
  AND make_date(t.year_no,v.month_no,1)<p.next_year_start
-- B01/C03为年度目标，即使以后把起止改为月，也不把年度目标误缩为单月目标。
),
shipment_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT new_ord_shipmentid::text AS shipment_id,
 new_shipping2_date::timestamp AS shipped_at,statecode
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb s CROSS JOIN context p
WHERE s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp>=p.start_date
 AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp<LEAST(p.end_exclusive::timestamp,p.observed_at)
),
product_codes AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT productnumber::text AS product_code,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT new_system_energy)=1 THEN MAX(new_system_energy)::numeric END AS energy_kwh
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(productnumber::text),'') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY productnumber::text
),
order_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT l.order_id,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name)=1
       AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.opportunity_id)=COUNT(DISTINCT l.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE t.team_name IS NOT NULL)
      THEN MIN(t.team_name) END AS team_name
FROM order_line_links l
LEFT JOIN opportunity_rows o ON o.opportunity_id=l.opportunity_id AND o.rn=1
LEFT JOIN owner_teams t ON t.owner_id=o.owner_id
GROUP BY l.order_id
-- 团队查找不以商机创建年份截断；发货事实仍按所选发货期间筛选。
-- 关联ID未匹配商机、负责人多团队或一单多团队时均保留未分配，不把整单强行归到已知团队。
),
shipment_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT i.new_ord_shipmentitemid::text AS line_id,i.new_ord_shipment_id::text AS shipment_id,
 i.new_ord_salesorder_id::text AS order_id,i.new_productcode::text AS product_code,
 i.new_qty::numeric AS qty,i.new_amount_base::numeric/100000000::numeric AS amount_yi,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY i.new_ord_shipmentitemid ORDER BY i.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST,i.createdon DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb i
WHERE i.new_ord_shipmentitemid IS NOT NULL AND i.new_qty>0
),
shipment_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT i.line_id,t.team_name,i.amount_yi,i.qty*pc.energy_kwh/1000000::numeric AS energy_gwh
FROM shipment_rows i JOIN shipment_headers s USING(shipment_id)
LEFT JOIN product_codes pc USING(product_code) LEFT JOIN order_teams t USING(order_id)
WHERE i.rn=1 AND s.statecode=0
),
target_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT team_name,SUM(amount_yi) AS target_amount,SUM(energy_gwh) AS target_energy,
 COUNT(DISTINCT target_id) AS target_record_count,COUNT(*) AS target_month_rows,
 COUNT(amount_yi) AS target_amount_nonnull_rows,COUNT(energy_gwh) AS target_energy_nonnull_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE amount_yi IS NULL) AS target_missing_amount_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE energy_gwh IS NULL) AS target_missing_energy_rows
FROM target_facts GROUP BY team_name
),
actual_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT team_name,SUM(amount_yi) AS actual_amount,SUM(energy_gwh) AS actual_energy,
 COUNT(DISTINCT line_id) AS actual_record_count,COUNT(amount_yi) AS actual_amount_nonnull_rows,
 COUNT(energy_gwh) AS actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
FROM shipment_facts GROUP BY team_name
),
team_gaps AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT COALESCE(v.team_name,'未能唯一分配团队') AS team_name,
 SUM(target_amount) AS target_amount,SUM(actual_amount) AS actual_amount,
 SUM(actual_amount)-SUM(target_amount) AS gap_amount,
 SUM(target_energy) AS target_energy,SUM(actual_energy) AS actual_energy,
 SUM(actual_energy)-SUM(target_energy) AS gap_energy,
 SUM(target_record_count)::bigint AS target_record_count,SUM(actual_record_count)::bigint AS actual_record_count,
 SUM(target_amount_nonnull_rows)::bigint AS target_amount_nonnull_rows,
 SUM(target_energy_nonnull_rows)::bigint AS target_energy_nonnull_rows,
 SUM(actual_amount_nonnull_rows)::bigint AS actual_amount_nonnull_rows,
 SUM(actual_energy_nonnull_rows)::bigint AS actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
 SUM(target_missing_amount_rows)::bigint AS target_missing_amount_rows,
 SUM(target_missing_energy_rows)::bigint AS target_missing_energy_rows,
 SUM(missing_amount_rows)::bigint AS missing_amount_rows,SUM(missing_energy_rows)::bigint AS missing_energy_rows,
 BOOL_OR(v.team_name IS NULL) AS unassigned_team
FROM (
 SELECT team_name,target_amount,target_energy,NULL::numeric AS actual_amount,NULL::numeric AS actual_energy,
 target_record_count,0::bigint AS actual_record_count,target_amount_nonnull_rows,target_energy_nonnull_rows,
 0::bigint AS actual_amount_nonnull_rows,0::bigint AS actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
 target_missing_amount_rows,target_missing_energy_rows,0::bigint AS missing_amount_rows,0::bigint AS missing_energy_rows
 FROM target_teams
 UNION ALL
 SELECT team_name,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,actual_amount,actual_energy,
 0::bigint,actual_record_count,0::bigint,0::bigint,actual_amount_nonnull_rows,actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
 0::bigint,0::bigint,missing_amount_rows,missing_energy_rows FROM actual_teams
) v GROUP BY v.team_name
-- 记录数0表示该路径下无该团队记录；有记录但非空计数0才表示核心字段全空。
-- C03仅展示目标侧有记录团队，C04仅展示实绩侧有记录团队；C05保留两侧对照解释。
),
c0_owner_team_sizes AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT owner_id,COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) AS candidate_team_count
FROM team_members GROUP BY owner_id
),
c0_target_assignment AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT t.target_id,t.opportunity_id,
 COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(owned.team_name),''),ot.team_name) AS current_target_team,
 linked.team_name AS team_via_linked_opportunity,
 sizes.candidate_team_count AS target_owner_team_candidates,
 linked_sizes.candidate_team_count AS opportunity_owner_team_candidates,
 (COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(owned.team_name),''),ot.team_name) IS DISTINCT FROM linked.team_name)
 AND linked.team_name IS NOT NULL AS team_paths_differ
FROM target_rows t LEFT JOIN teams owned ON owned.team_id=t.owning_team_id
LEFT JOIN owner_teams ot ON ot.owner_id=t.owner_id
LEFT JOIN c0_owner_team_sizes sizes ON sizes.owner_id=t.owner_id
LEFT JOIN opportunity_rows o ON o.opportunity_id=t.opportunity_id AND o.rn=1
LEFT JOIN owner_teams linked ON linked.owner_id=o.owner_id
LEFT JOIN c0_owner_team_sizes linked_sizes ON linked_sizes.owner_id=o.owner_id
WHERE t.rn=1
),
c0_team_assignment_audit AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM c0_target_assignment WHERE team_paths_differ) AS target_opportunity_team_mismatch_records,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM target_facts WHERE team_name IS NULL) AS unassigned_target_month_rows,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipment_facts WHERE team_name IS NULL) AS unassigned_shipment_rows,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM c0_owner_team_sizes WHERE candidate_team_count>1) AS owners_with_multiple_teams,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (
   SELECT * FROM c0_target_assignment WHERE team_paths_differ ORDER BY target_id LIMIT 50
 ) x) AS target_assignment_difference_examples_limit50
-- 两条团队归属路径对照，不擅自用模糊团队名称或MAX/MIN选一个团队代替。
),
metric_results AS (
SELECT 17 AS sort_no,'C04'::text AS code,'产品部累计实际销售额／电量'::text AS metric_name,
 t.team_name::text AS product_team,t.actual_amount::numeric AS amount_yi,t.actual_energy::numeric AS energy_gwh,
 NULL::bigint AS item_count,NULL::numeric AS ratio_value,NULL::numeric AS days_value,
 (CASE WHEN actual_amount_nonnull_rows=0 AND actual_energy_nonnull_rows=0 THEN '有实绩记录，但核心计算字段全空' WHEN missing_amount_rows>0 OR missing_energy_rows>0 THEN '实绩字段部分缺失；当前为已知值合计' ELSE '已有实绩记录并可计算' END)::text AS status,
 '按团队分别保留来源记录计数；记录不存在与核心字段全空分别说明。目标owningteam/owner与实绩商机owner的归属对照在明细；不强行补0，不凭名称归并产品部。'::text AS note,
 to_jsonb(t)||jsonb_build_object('团队归属核对',(SELECT to_jsonb(q) FROM c0_team_assignment_audit q)) AS detail
FROM team_gaps t WHERE actual_record_count>0
)
SELECT r.code AS "指标序号",r.metric_name AS "指标名称",r.product_team AS "产品团队",
p.start_date AS "期间开始",p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",r.item_count AS "数量",
r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
CASE WHEN r.status='查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' THEN
 CASE WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
        OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围' END ELSE r.status END AS "计算说明状态",
r.note AS "取值说明",r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results r CROSS JOIN context p ORDER BY r.sort_no,r.product_team NULLS LAST;;

C05.name: 产品部实际销售与目标差距
C05.definition: 按同一产品团队逐项计算C04实际销售－C03年度目标，金额和电量分别计算；小于0代表该团队不足。
C05.formula: 如同一产品部的累计实际销售减年度目标小于 0，则判定“该产品部存在销售缺口”成立。金额、电量分别判断。关联风险 2 时，须匹配该产品部的电芯或 PACK 待签商机。差距用于定位缺口归属，具体推进卡点按 C07 核实。
C05.caliber: 已有按团队目标与实际的基础输出；未发现独立输出实际－目标的C05指标。
C05.attributes: （由其他指标计算；SQL 读取字段见“指标SQL计算步骤”）
C05.dashboardSql: 已有按团队目标与实际的基础输出；未发现独立输出实际－目标的C05指标。
C05.notes: C0专项增加来源记录数、非空计数与团队归属路径诊断。C03仅目标有记录团队，C04仅实绩有记录团队，C05明确未查到哪一侧；不把未出现的团队误报为核心字段全空，不强行补0。 当目标或实绩团队仅在一侧出现时，记录数会明确为0，不能仅凭此就认定源字段全空。
C05.sqlStatus: 按结果动态判定（见 SQL 中 status 的 CASE）
C05.role: 根因判定 / 行动跟踪
C05.ctes: parameters → context → opportunity_rows → order_line_links → product_types → teams → team_members → owner_teams → target_rows → target_facts → shipment_headers → product_codes → order_teams → shipment_rows → shipment_facts → target_teams → actual_teams → team_gaps → c0_owner_team_sizes → c0_target_assignment → c0_team_assignment_audit
C05.sql:
-- 指标 C05 产品部实际销售与目标差距：可直接调用 SQL（PostgreSQL 只读；业务表均为 ded_public）
-- 来源：穿透式分析_55种指标_查询_2025_C0及环节周期合并修订.sql 第 18 个指标分支；仅保留该指标依赖的 21 个 CTE，结果与整段执行时该指标的行一致。
-- 修改统计期间：只改 parameters 中的 start_date / end_exclusive（结束日不含）；无绑定参数。
WITH
parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive,
       CURRENT_TIMESTAMP::timestamp AS observed_at,
       ARRAY['1']::text[] AS strategic_levels,
       ARRAY['1','2']::text[] AS focus_levels,
       1000000::numeric AS target_power_units_per_gwh
-- 默认2025全年；结束日不含。仅修改这里，不需要填写绑定参数。
-- 战略客户默认等级1；重点跟踪默认1战略＋2重要。0核心/4BG不自动纳入。
-- 目标power暂沿用当前M0007单项的kWh换算，不用quantity冒充电量。
),
context AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT p.*,LEAST(observed_at,end_exclusive::timestamp) AS cutoff,
       make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1) AS year_start,
       make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer+1,1,1) AS next_year_start,
       GREATEST(0::numeric,LEAST(1::numeric,
        (LEAST(observed_at,end_exclusive::timestamp)::date-make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1))::numeric
        /(make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer+1,1,1)-make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1)))) AS time_progress
FROM parameters p
),
opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.opportunityid::text AS opportunity_id,o.parentaccountid::text AS account_id,
       o.name::text AS project_name,o.ownerid::text AS owner_id,
       CASE WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯'
            WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS product_type,
       o.new_isqualifiedsuppliers::text AS supplier_flag,
       o.new_istechnologyagreement::text AS technical_flag,
       o.new_iswarranty::text AS warranty_flag,
       o.new_processstage::text AS process_stage,o.statecode::text AS system_state,o.new_demandinput::text AS demand_status,
       o.createdon::timestamp AS created_at,o.new_stage1enddate::timestamp AS s1,
       o.new_stage2enddate::timestamp AS s2,o.new_stage3enddate::timestamp AS s3,
       o.new_stage4enddate::timestamp AS s4,o.new_stage5enddate::timestamp AS s5,
       o.new_cdastartdate::timestamp AS new_cdastartdate,
       o.new_cdaenddate::timestamp AS new_cdaenddate,
       o.new_approved_time_acneed::timestamp AS new_approved_time_acneed,
       o.new_submit_time_acneed::timestamp AS new_submit_time_acneed,
       o.new_issalesforecast_date::timestamp AS new_issalesforecast_date,
       o.new_approved_time_projectassess::timestamp AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
       o.new_submit_time_projectassess::timestamp AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
       o.new_sampletestpass_time::timestamp AS new_sampletestpass_time,
       o.new_sampletime::timestamp AS new_sampletime,
       o.new_technicalsigningdate::timestamp AS new_technicalsigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_techcon::timestamp AS new_submit_time_techcon,
       o.new_warrantysigningdate::timestamp AS new_warrantysigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_qsl::timestamp AS new_submit_time_qsl,
       o.new_isneedcda::text AS new_isneedcda,
       o.new_approvalstatus_acneed::text AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
       o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess::text AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
       o.new_approvalstatus_techcon::text AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
       o.new_approvalstatus_qsl::text AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
       o.new_sampletestresult::text AS new_sampletestresult,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY o.opportunityid ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST,o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb o
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(o.opportunityid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT l.new_opportunity_id::text AS opportunity_id,l.salesorderid::text AS order_id
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb l
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(l.new_opportunity_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(BTRIM(l.salesorderid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT new_product_typeid::text AS product_type_id,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT new_accproducttype::text)=1 THEN MIN(new_accproducttype::text) END AS type_code
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb GROUP BY new_product_typeid::text
),
teams AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT teamid::text AS team_id,MAX(name::text) AS team_name
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb GROUP BY teamid::text
),
team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT tm.systemuserid::text AS owner_id,t.name::text AS team_name
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb tm
JOIN (SELECT team_id,team_name AS name FROM teams) t ON t.team_id=tm.teamid::text
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(t.name::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT owner_id,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name)=1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
FROM team_members GROUP BY owner_id
-- 多团队负责人不将一笔金额重复分摊到全部团队；保留未分配并在明细显示。
),
target_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT t.new_targetid::text AS target_id,t.new_opportunity_id::text AS opportunity_id,
       t.new_year::integer AS year_no,t.new_account_id::text AS account_id,t.ownerid::text AS owner_id,t.owningteam::text AS owning_team_id,
       t.new_producttype_id::text AS product_type_id,
       t.new_month1,t.new_month2,t.new_month3,t.new_month4,t.new_month5,t.new_month6,
       t.new_month7,t.new_month8,t.new_month9,t.new_month10,t.new_month11,t.new_month12,
       t.new_month1_power,t.new_month2_power,t.new_month3_power,t.new_month4_power,t.new_month5_power,t.new_month6_power,
       t.new_month7_power,t.new_month8_power,t.new_month9_power,t.new_month10_power,t.new_month11_power,t.new_month12_power,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(t.new_opportunity_id::text),''),t.new_targetid::text),t.new_year
        ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST,t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb t CROSS JOIN context p
WHERE t.new_year::integer=EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date)::integer AND t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
-- 目标先按商机＋年取最新。空商机ID以目标ID独立保留，避免全部空ID挤成一条。
),
target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT t.target_id,t.account_id,
       CASE WHEN pt.type_code IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯' WHEN pt.type_code IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他' END AS product_type,COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(owned.team_name),''),ot.team_name) AS team_name,
       v.amount_yuan::numeric/100000000::numeric AS amount_yi,
       v.power_value::numeric/p.target_power_units_per_gwh AS energy_gwh
FROM target_rows t CROSS JOIN context p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (1,t.new_month1,t.new_month1_power),
(2,t.new_month2,t.new_month2_power),
(3,t.new_month3,t.new_month3_power),
(4,t.new_month4,t.new_month4_power),
(5,t.new_month5,t.new_month5_power),
(6,t.new_month6,t.new_month6_power),
(7,t.new_month7,t.new_month7_power),
(8,t.new_month8,t.new_month8_power),
(9,t.new_month9,t.new_month9_power),
(10,t.new_month10,t.new_month10_power),
(11,t.new_month11,t.new_month11_power),
(12,t.new_month12,t.new_month12_power)) v(month_no,amount_yuan,power_value)
LEFT JOIN product_types pt USING(product_type_id) LEFT JOIN owner_teams ot USING(owner_id)
LEFT JOIN teams owned ON owned.team_id=t.owning_team_id
WHERE t.rn=1 AND make_date(t.year_no,v.month_no,1)>=p.year_start
  AND make_date(t.year_no,v.month_no,1)<p.next_year_start
-- B01/C03为年度目标，即使以后把起止改为月，也不把年度目标误缩为单月目标。
),
shipment_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT new_ord_shipmentid::text AS shipment_id,
 new_shipping2_date::timestamp AS shipped_at,statecode
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb s CROSS JOIN context p
WHERE s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp>=p.start_date
 AND s.new_shipping2_date::timestamp<LEAST(p.end_exclusive::timestamp,p.observed_at)
),
product_codes AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT productnumber::text AS product_code,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT new_system_energy)=1 THEN MAX(new_system_energy)::numeric END AS energy_kwh
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(productnumber::text),'') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY productnumber::text
),
order_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT l.order_id,
 CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name)=1
       AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.opportunity_id)=COUNT(DISTINCT l.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE t.team_name IS NOT NULL)
      THEN MIN(t.team_name) END AS team_name
FROM order_line_links l
LEFT JOIN opportunity_rows o ON o.opportunity_id=l.opportunity_id AND o.rn=1
LEFT JOIN owner_teams t ON t.owner_id=o.owner_id
GROUP BY l.order_id
-- 团队查找不以商机创建年份截断；发货事实仍按所选发货期间筛选。
-- 关联ID未匹配商机、负责人多团队或一单多团队时均保留未分配，不把整单强行归到已知团队。
),
shipment_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT i.new_ord_shipmentitemid::text AS line_id,i.new_ord_shipment_id::text AS shipment_id,
 i.new_ord_salesorder_id::text AS order_id,i.new_productcode::text AS product_code,
 i.new_qty::numeric AS qty,i.new_amount_base::numeric/100000000::numeric AS amount_yi,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY i.new_ord_shipmentitemid ORDER BY i.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST,i.createdon DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb i
WHERE i.new_ord_shipmentitemid IS NOT NULL AND i.new_qty>0
),
shipment_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT i.line_id,t.team_name,i.amount_yi,i.qty*pc.energy_kwh/1000000::numeric AS energy_gwh
FROM shipment_rows i JOIN shipment_headers s USING(shipment_id)
LEFT JOIN product_codes pc USING(product_code) LEFT JOIN order_teams t USING(order_id)
WHERE i.rn=1 AND s.statecode=0
),
target_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT team_name,SUM(amount_yi) AS target_amount,SUM(energy_gwh) AS target_energy,
 COUNT(DISTINCT target_id) AS target_record_count,COUNT(*) AS target_month_rows,
 COUNT(amount_yi) AS target_amount_nonnull_rows,COUNT(energy_gwh) AS target_energy_nonnull_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE amount_yi IS NULL) AS target_missing_amount_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE energy_gwh IS NULL) AS target_missing_energy_rows
FROM target_facts GROUP BY team_name
),
actual_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT team_name,SUM(amount_yi) AS actual_amount,SUM(energy_gwh) AS actual_energy,
 COUNT(DISTINCT line_id) AS actual_record_count,COUNT(amount_yi) AS actual_amount_nonnull_rows,
 COUNT(energy_gwh) AS actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
FROM shipment_facts GROUP BY team_name
),
team_gaps AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT COALESCE(v.team_name,'未能唯一分配团队') AS team_name,
 SUM(target_amount) AS target_amount,SUM(actual_amount) AS actual_amount,
 SUM(actual_amount)-SUM(target_amount) AS gap_amount,
 SUM(target_energy) AS target_energy,SUM(actual_energy) AS actual_energy,
 SUM(actual_energy)-SUM(target_energy) AS gap_energy,
 SUM(target_record_count)::bigint AS target_record_count,SUM(actual_record_count)::bigint AS actual_record_count,
 SUM(target_amount_nonnull_rows)::bigint AS target_amount_nonnull_rows,
 SUM(target_energy_nonnull_rows)::bigint AS target_energy_nonnull_rows,
 SUM(actual_amount_nonnull_rows)::bigint AS actual_amount_nonnull_rows,
 SUM(actual_energy_nonnull_rows)::bigint AS actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
 SUM(target_missing_amount_rows)::bigint AS target_missing_amount_rows,
 SUM(target_missing_energy_rows)::bigint AS target_missing_energy_rows,
 SUM(missing_amount_rows)::bigint AS missing_amount_rows,SUM(missing_energy_rows)::bigint AS missing_energy_rows,
 BOOL_OR(v.team_name IS NULL) AS unassigned_team
FROM (
 SELECT team_name,target_amount,target_energy,NULL::numeric AS actual_amount,NULL::numeric AS actual_energy,
 target_record_count,0::bigint AS actual_record_count,target_amount_nonnull_rows,target_energy_nonnull_rows,
 0::bigint AS actual_amount_nonnull_rows,0::bigint AS actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
 target_missing_amount_rows,target_missing_energy_rows,0::bigint AS missing_amount_rows,0::bigint AS missing_energy_rows
 FROM target_teams
 UNION ALL
 SELECT team_name,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,actual_amount,actual_energy,
 0::bigint,actual_record_count,0::bigint,0::bigint,actual_amount_nonnull_rows,actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
 0::bigint,0::bigint,missing_amount_rows,missing_energy_rows FROM actual_teams
) v GROUP BY v.team_name
-- 记录数0表示该路径下无该团队记录；有记录但非空计数0才表示核心字段全空。
-- C03仅展示目标侧有记录团队，C04仅展示实绩侧有记录团队；C05保留两侧对照解释。
),
c0_owner_team_sizes AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT owner_id,COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) AS candidate_team_count
FROM team_members GROUP BY owner_id
),
c0_target_assignment AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT t.target_id,t.opportunity_id,
 COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(owned.team_name),''),ot.team_name) AS current_target_team,
 linked.team_name AS team_via_linked_opportunity,
 sizes.candidate_team_count AS target_owner_team_candidates,
 linked_sizes.candidate_team_count AS opportunity_owner_team_candidates,
 (COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(owned.team_name),''),ot.team_name) IS DISTINCT FROM linked.team_name)
 AND linked.team_name IS NOT NULL AS team_paths_differ
FROM target_rows t LEFT JOIN teams owned ON owned.team_id=t.owning_team_id
LEFT JOIN owner_teams ot ON ot.owner_id=t.owner_id
LEFT JOIN c0_owner_team_sizes sizes ON sizes.owner_id=t.owner_id
LEFT JOIN opportunity_rows o ON o.opportunity_id=t.opportunity_id AND o.rn=1
LEFT JOIN owner_teams linked ON linked.owner_id=o.owner_id
LEFT JOIN c0_owner_team_sizes linked_sizes ON linked_sizes.owner_id=o.owner_id
WHERE t.rn=1
),
c0_team_assignment_audit AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM c0_target_assignment WHERE team_paths_differ) AS target_opportunity_team_mismatch_records,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM target_facts WHERE team_name IS NULL) AS unassigned_target_month_rows,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipment_facts WHERE team_name IS NULL) AS unassigned_shipment_rows,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM c0_owner_team_sizes WHERE candidate_team_count>1) AS owners_with_multiple_teams,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (
   SELECT * FROM c0_target_assignment WHERE team_paths_differ ORDER BY target_id LIMIT 50
 ) x) AS target_assignment_difference_examples_limit50
-- 两条团队归属路径对照，不擅自用模糊团队名称或MAX/MIN选一个团队代替。
),
metric_results AS (
SELECT 18 AS sort_no,'C05'::text AS code,'产品部实际销售与目标差距'::text AS metric_name,
 t.team_name::text AS product_team,t.gap_amount::numeric AS amount_yi,t.gap_energy::numeric AS energy_gwh,
 NULL::bigint AS item_count,NULL::numeric AS ratio_value,NULL::numeric AS days_value,
 (CASE WHEN target_record_count=0 THEN '未查到同名团队年度目标；不可算差额' WHEN actual_record_count=0 THEN '所选期间未查到同名团队实绩；不可算差额' WHEN gap_amount IS NULL AND gap_energy IS NULL THEN '两侧有记录，但无可配对计算字段' WHEN target_missing_amount_rows>0 OR target_missing_energy_rows>0 OR missing_amount_rows>0 OR missing_energy_rows>0 THEN '两侧部分字段缺失；差额为已知值之差' ELSE '目标与实绩已配对' END)::text AS status,
 '按团队分别保留来源记录计数；记录不存在与核心字段全空分别说明。目标owningteam/owner与实绩商机owner的归属对照在明细；不强行补0，不凭名称归并产品部。'::text AS note,
 to_jsonb(t)||jsonb_build_object('团队归属核对',(SELECT to_jsonb(q) FROM c0_team_assignment_audit q)) AS detail
FROM team_gaps t WHERE TRUE
)
SELECT r.code AS "指标序号",r.metric_name AS "指标名称",r.product_team AS "产品团队",
p.start_date AS "期间开始",p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",r.item_count AS "数量",
r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
CASE WHEN r.status='查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' THEN
 CASE WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
        OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围' END ELSE r.status END AS "计算说明状态",
r.note AS "取值说明",r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results r CROSS JOIN context p ORDER BY r.sort_no,r.product_team NULLS LAST;;

C08.name: 重点跟踪商机占未签单预测的比例
C08.definition: R04 战略及重点客户未签单商机预测 ÷ R02 全部未签单商机预测。金额与电量按相同年度、组织范围分别计算。 签单判定按本次确认：商机ID关联订单明细.new_opportunity_id，再由明细.salesorderid关联订单.salesorderid；至少1个去重订单ID为已签，0个为未签。不使用批量合同确认枚举。
C08.formula: 如分母大于 0，且重点跟踪商机占未签单预测的比例严格低于 70%，则判定“重点跟踪商机承接不足”这一原因成立。等于 70% 时本项不成立。分母为 0 时不计算比例。
C08.attributes:
LE02-A0043 项目月度销售预测.项目（new_opportunity_id，空 0%）
LE06-A0053 销售目标管理.项目号（new_opportunity_id，空 0%）
