P0-06.sql:
-- 指标 P0-06 申请需求输入平均周期：可直接调用 SQL（PostgreSQL 只读；业务表均为 ded_public）
-- 来源：穿透式分析_55种指标_查询_2025_C0及环节周期合并修订.sql 第 27 个指标分支；仅保留该指标依赖的 18 个 CTE，结果与整段执行时该指标的行一致。
-- 修改统计期间：只改 parameters 中的 start_date / end_exclusive（结束日不含）；无绑定参数。
WITH
parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive,
       CURRENT_TIMESTAMP::timestamp AS observed_at,
       ARRAY['1']::text[] AS strategic_levels,
       ARRAY['1','2']::text[] AS focus_levels,
       1000000::numeric AS target_power_units_per_gwh
-- 默认2025全年；结束日不含。仅修改这里，不需要填写绑定参数。
-- 战略客户默认等级1；重点跟踪默认1战略＋2重要。0核心/4BG不自动纳入。
-- 目标power暂沿用当前M0007单项的kWh换算，不用quantity冒充电量。
),
context AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT p.*,LEAST(observed_at,end_exclusive::timestamp) AS cutoff,
       make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1) AS year_start,
       make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer+1,1,1) AS next_year_start,
       GREATEST(0::numeric,LEAST(1::numeric,
        (LEAST(observed_at,end_exclusive::timestamp)::date-make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1))::numeric
        /(make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer+1,1,1)-make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1)))) AS time_progress
FROM parameters p
),
account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT a.accountid::text AS account_id,a.name::text AS account_name,
       a.new_accountlevel::text AS level_code,
       a.new_sapdate::timestamp AS sap_created_at,a.new_sapsubmitdate::timestamp AS sap_submitted_at,
       a.new_approved_time_facreview::timestamp AS account_factory_approved_at,
       a.new_submit_time_facreview::timestamp AS account_factory_submitted_at,
       a.new_sinosurestartdate::timestamp AS account_sinosure_start,
       a.new_sinosureenddate::timestamp AS account_sinosure_end,
       a.new_submit_time_accredit::timestamp AS account_credit_submitted_at,
       a.new_approvaltime_accredit::timestamp AS account_credit_approved_at,
       a.new_cdastartdate::timestamp AS account_cda_start,
       a.new_cdaenddate::timestamp AS account_cda_end,
       a.new_cda_submittime::timestamp AS account_cda_submitted_at,
       a.new_cda_approved_time::timestamp AS account_cda_approved_at,
       a.new_approvalstatus_facreview::text AS account_factory_approval_status,
       a.new_sapcode::text AS sap_code,a.new_issap::text AS sap_registered,
       a.new_issapnew::text AS sap_registration_kind,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY a.accountid ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST,a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb a WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(a.accountid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT account_id,account_name,level_code,sap_created_at,sap_submitted_at,account_factory_approved_at,account_factory_submitted_at,account_sinosure_start,account_sinosure_end,account_credit_submitted_at,account_credit_approved_at,account_cda_start,account_cda_end,account_cda_submitted_at,account_cda_approved_at,account_factory_approval_status,sap_code,sap_registered,sap_registration_kind FROM account_rows WHERE rn=1
),
opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.opportunityid::text AS opportunity_id,o.parentaccountid::text AS account_id,
       o.name::text AS project_name,o.ownerid::text AS owner_id,
       CASE WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯'
            WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS product_type,
       o.new_isqualifiedsuppliers::text AS supplier_flag,
       o.new_istechnologyagreement::text AS technical_flag,
       o.new_iswarranty::text AS warranty_flag,
       o.new_processstage::text AS process_stage,o.statecode::text AS system_state,o.new_demandinput::text AS demand_status,
       o.createdon::timestamp AS created_at,o.new_stage1enddate::timestamp AS s1,
       o.new_stage2enddate::timestamp AS s2,o.new_stage3enddate::timestamp AS s3,
       o.new_stage4enddate::timestamp AS s4,o.new_stage5enddate::timestamp AS s5,
       o.new_cdastartdate::timestamp AS new_cdastartdate,
       o.new_cdaenddate::timestamp AS new_cdaenddate,
       o.new_approved_time_acneed::timestamp AS new_approved_time_acneed,
       o.new_submit_time_acneed::timestamp AS new_submit_time_acneed,
       o.new_issalesforecast_date::timestamp AS new_issalesforecast_date,
       o.new_approved_time_projectassess::timestamp AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
       o.new_submit_time_projectassess::timestamp AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
       o.new_sampletestpass_time::timestamp AS new_sampletestpass_time,
       o.new_sampletime::timestamp AS new_sampletime,
       o.new_technicalsigningdate::timestamp AS new_technicalsigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_techcon::timestamp AS new_submit_time_techcon,
       o.new_warrantysigningdate::timestamp AS new_warrantysigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_qsl::timestamp AS new_submit_time_qsl,
       o.new_isneedcda::text AS new_isneedcda,
       o.new_approvalstatus_acneed::text AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
       o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess::text AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
       o.new_approvalstatus_techcon::text AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
       o.new_approvalstatus_qsl::text AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
       o.new_sampletestresult::text AS new_sampletestresult,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY o.opportunityid ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST,o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb o
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(o.opportunityid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.opportunity_id,o.account_id,o.project_name,o.owner_id,o.product_type,o.process_stage,o.demand_status,
       o.created_at,o.s1,o.s2,o.s3,o.s4,o.s5,a.account_name,a.level_code,
       o.new_cdastartdate,
       o.new_cdaenddate,
       o.new_approved_time_acneed,
       o.new_submit_time_acneed,
       o.new_issalesforecast_date,
       o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
       o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
       o.new_sampletestpass_time,
       o.new_sampletime,
       o.new_technicalsigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_techcon,
       o.new_warrantysigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_qsl,
       o.new_isneedcda,
       o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
       o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
       o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
       o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
       o.new_sampletestresult,a.sap_created_at,a.sap_submitted_at,a.sap_code,a.account_factory_approved_at,a.account_factory_submitted_at,a.account_sinosure_start,a.account_sinosure_end,a.account_credit_submitted_at,a.account_credit_approved_at,a.account_cda_start,a.account_cda_end,a.account_cda_submitted_at,a.account_cda_approved_at,a.account_factory_approval_status
FROM opportunity_rows o LEFT JOIN accounts a USING(account_id) CROSS JOIN context p
WHERE o.rn=1 AND (o.created_at IS NULL OR o.created_at<=p.cutoff)
),
orders AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT salesorderid::text AS order_id
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(salesorderid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
-- 签单严格按“有关联订单”确认：不使用订单头opportunityid，也不使用合同确认枚举。
-- 未额外限定审批、取消状态或订单日期；本查询统计的是关联关系现状，不是历史签单快照。
),
order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT l.new_opportunity_id::text AS opportunity_id,l.salesorderid::text AS order_id
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb l
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(l.new_opportunity_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(BTRIM(l.salesorderid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT l.opportunity_id,COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
FROM order_line_links l JOIN orders o USING(order_id) GROUP BY l.opportunity_id
),
bid_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT b.project_name::text AS project_name,b.seq_no::text AS bid_id,b.seq_no AS bid_seq,b.remark::text AS remark,
       NULLIF(BTRIM(b.input_time::text),'')::timestamp AS input_at,
       NULLIF(BTRIM(b.bid_open_time::text),'')::timestamp AS open_at,
       NULLIF(BTRIM(b.winner_announce_time::text),'')::timestamp AS result_at
FROM ded_public.p_fm_bid_project_info b
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(b.project_name::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
bid_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT project_name,bid_id,remark,input_at,result_at FROM (
 SELECT b.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY project_name ORDER BY input_at DESC NULLS LAST,bid_seq DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
 FROM bid_rows b CROSS JOIN context p WHERE b.input_at IS NOT NULL AND b.input_at<=p.cutoff
) r WHERE rn=1
),
opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.*,COALESCE(s.order_count,0) AS order_count,COALESCE(s.order_count,0)>0 AS signed,
       b.project_name IS NOT NULL AS entered_bid,
       b.project_name IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(b.remark,'') NOT LIKE '%弃标%'
          AND (b.result_at IS NULL OR b.result_at>p.cutoff) AS bidding,
       b.bid_id,b.input_at,b.result_at
FROM opportunities o LEFT JOIN signed_orders s USING(opportunity_id)
LEFT JOIN bid_latest b ON b.project_name=o.project_name CROSS JOIN context p
),
node_quote_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT q.new_quoteapplyid::text AS quote_id,q.createdon::timestamp AS created_at,
 q.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp AS submitted_at,q.new_approved_time::timestamp AS approved_at,
 q.new_approvalstatus::text AS approval_status
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapply_esb q
WHERE q.new_quoteapplyid IS NOT NULL
),
node_quote_links AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT d.new_opportunity_id::text AS opportunity_id,d.new_quoteapply_id::text AS quote_id
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapplydetail_esb d
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(d.new_opportunity_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL
 AND NULLIF(BTRIM(d.new_quoteapply_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
node_quote_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT opportunity_id,quote_id,submitted_at,approved_at,approval_status FROM (
 SELECT o.opportunity_id,q.quote_id,q.submitted_at,q.approved_at,q.approval_status,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY o.opportunity_id ORDER BY q.created_at DESC NULLS LAST,q.quote_id DESC) AS rn
 FROM opportunity_flags o JOIN node_quote_links l USING(opportunity_id)
 JOIN node_quote_headers q USING(quote_id) CROSS JOIN context p
 WHERE q.created_at<=p.cutoff

) ranked WHERE rn=1
),
node_cycle_source AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.opportunity_id,o.product_type,n.metric_code,n.phase_code,n.started_at,
 n.finished_at,n.entered_at,n.active_flag,n.event_id,
 n.started_at>=p.start_date AND n.started_at<p.end_exclusive AND n.started_at<=p.cutoff AS in_window,
 p.cutoff
FROM opportunity_flags o LEFT JOIN node_quote_latest q USING(opportunity_id)
CROSS JOIN context p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
('P0-03'::text,'P0'::text,o.new_cdastartdate,o.new_cdaenddate,o.new_cdastartdate,COALESCE((o.new_isneedcda='2'),FALSE),(o.opportunity_id)::text),
('P0-04'::text,'P0'::text,o.new_submit_time_acneed,o.new_approved_time_acneed,o.new_submit_time_acneed,COALESCE((o.new_approvalstatus_acneed='2'),FALSE),(o.opportunity_id)::text),
('P0-06'::text,'P0'::text,o.new_submit_time_acneed,o.new_approved_time_acneed,o.new_submit_time_acneed,COALESCE((o.new_approvalstatus_acneed='2'),FALSE),(o.opportunity_id)::text),
('P0-07'::text,'P0'::text,o.created_at,o.new_issalesforecast_date,NULL::timestamp,COALESCE((FALSE),FALSE),(o.opportunity_id)::text),
('P1-03'::text,'P1'::text,o.account_factory_submitted_at,o.account_factory_approved_at,o.account_factory_submitted_at,COALESCE((o.account_factory_approval_status='2'),FALSE),(o.account_id)::text),
('P1-04'::text,'P1'::text,o.new_submit_time_projectassess,o.new_approved_time_projectassess,o.new_submit_time_projectassess,COALESCE((o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess='2'),FALSE),(o.opportunity_id)::text),
('P1-05'::text,'P1'::text,o.new_sampletime,o.new_sampletestpass_time,o.new_sampletime,COALESCE((o.new_sampletestresult IS NULL),FALSE),(o.opportunity_id)::text),
('P1-07'::text,'P1'::text,q.submitted_at,CASE WHEN q.approval_status='3' THEN q.approved_at END,q.submitted_at,COALESCE((q.approval_status='2'),FALSE),(q.quote_id)::text),
('P2-03'::text,'P2'::text,o.new_submit_time_techcon,o.new_technicalsigningdate,o.new_submit_time_techcon,COALESCE((o.new_approvalstatus_techcon='2'),FALSE),(o.opportunity_id)::text),
('P2-04'::text,'P2'::text,o.new_submit_time_qsl,o.new_warrantysigningdate,o.new_submit_time_qsl,COALESCE((o.new_approvalstatus_qsl='2'),FALSE),(o.opportunity_id)::text)
) n(metric_code,phase_code,started_at,finished_at,entered_at,active_flag,event_id)
-- 小环节按自身起止；不以当前阶段枚举限定已经历的环节。
-- P0-07未确认独立发起日期，本次保留原累计创建至完成口径并明确标注。
-- P3-03/P3-05按用户指令暂不计算，不读取其完成字段来拼接阶段起点。
),
node_cycle_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT f.*,
 CASE WHEN in_window AND event_id IS NOT NULL AND finished_at>=started_at AND finished_at<=cutoff
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (finished_at-started_at))/86400::numeric
      WHEN in_window AND event_id IS NOT NULL AND entered_at IS NOT NULL AND entered_at<=cutoff
        AND (finished_at>cutoff OR (finished_at IS NULL AND active_flag))
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (cutoff-started_at))/86400::numeric END AS duration_days,
 in_window AND event_id IS NOT NULL AND finished_at>=started_at AND finished_at<=cutoff AS completed_valid,
 in_window AND event_id IS NOT NULL AND entered_at IS NOT NULL AND entered_at<=cutoff
  AND (finished_at>cutoff OR (finished_at IS NULL AND active_flag)) AS inflight_valid
FROM node_cycle_source f
-- 完成值早于真实开始时不取ABS或0；无法确认仍在途的缺失完成日期不以当前时间补齐。
),
node_cycle_means AS MATERIALIZED (
WITH event_samples AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT metric_code,product_type,event_id,duration_days,completed_valid,inflight_valid
 FROM node_cycle_facts WHERE duration_days IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL
 SELECT DISTINCT metric_code,'全部'::text AS product_type,event_id,duration_days,completed_valid,inflight_valid
 FROM node_cycle_facts WHERE duration_days IS NOT NULL
), sample_stats AS (
 SELECT metric_code,product_type,COUNT(*) AS sample_count,AVG(duration_days) AS mean_days,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE completed_valid) AS completed_count,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE inflight_valid) AS inflight_count
 FROM event_samples GROUP BY metric_code,product_type
), quality AS (
 SELECT metric_code,CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type)=1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
 COUNT(*) AS linked_source_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE in_window) AS entry_window_rows,
 COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) FILTER(WHERE in_window) AS entered_event_count,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE in_window AND finished_at IS NULL) AS missing_end_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE started_at IS NULL) AS missing_start_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE event_id IS NULL) AS missing_event_id_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE in_window AND finished_at<started_at) AS end_before_start_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE in_window AND finished_at>cutoff AND NOT COALESCE(inflight_valid,FALSE)) AS future_end_without_entry_proof_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE in_window AND finished_at IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(inflight_valid,FALSE)) AS unknown_completion_rows
 FROM node_cycle_facts GROUP BY metric_code,GROUPING SETS((),(product_type))
)
SELECT q.*,COALESCE(s.sample_count,0) AS sample_count,s.mean_days,
 COALESCE(s.completed_count,0) AS completed_count,COALESCE(s.inflight_count,0) AS inflight_count
FROM quality q LEFT JOIN sample_stats s USING(metric_code,product_type)
-- 同一事件可出现在多个产品分组；各分组样本数不可相加当总体，总体已单独按事件去重。
),
metric_results AS (
SELECT 27 AS sort_no,'P0-06'::text AS code,'申请需求输入平均周期'::text AS metric_name,
NULL::text AS product_team,NULL::numeric AS amount_yi,NULL::numeric AS energy_gwh,
n.sample_count::bigint AS item_count,NULL::numeric AS ratio_value,n.mean_days::numeric AS days_value,
CASE WHEN n.sample_count>0 THEN '自身起止已映射；按真实事件去重计算'
 WHEN COALESCE(n.entry_window_rows,0)=0 THEN '已映射；起始时间缺失或不在所选窗口'
 ELSE '已映射；没有有效起止配对，原因见明细' END::text AS status,
'商机.new_approved_time_acneed－商机.new_submit_time_acneed，换算天后取平均。已完成取真实结束，在途取观察截止；以本环节开始时间归所选期间。已进入后续阶段的记录也保留，不限定当前阶段枚举。 与客户需求审批共用同一实际事件，两个指标各自展示，不能作为两次业务合计。 总体按真实事件去重；缺起止数据与缺字段映射分开列示。分组样本不可直接相加。'::text AS note,
(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM node_cycle_means x WHERE x.metric_code='P0-06') AS detail
FROM context p LEFT JOIN node_cycle_means n ON n.metric_code='P0-06' AND n.product_type='全部'
)
SELECT r.code AS "指标序号",r.metric_name AS "指标名称",r.product_team AS "产品团队",
p.start_date AS "期间开始",p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",r.item_count AS "数量",
r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
CASE WHEN r.status='查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' THEN
 CASE WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
        OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围' END ELSE r.status END AS "计算说明状态",
r.note AS "取值说明",r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results r CROSS JOIN context p ORDER BY r.sort_no,r.product_team NULLS LAST;;

P0-07.name: 创建或更新销售预测平均周期
P0-07.definition: 暂沿用商机.createdon至商机.new_issalesforecast_date的累计耗时，尚未获得独立的预测创建/更新发起时间；不当作独立预测操作耗时。
P0-07.formula: 对已实际进入本环节的有效事件计算周期；不以当前阶段枚举排除已到后续阶段的历史事件。同一事件去重，按电芯/PACK计算动态均值；单笔周期严格大于同组均值1.5倍才判超期。
P0-07.attributes:
LE01-A0327 商机管理.销售预测完成时间（new_issalesforecast_date，空 48.28%）
LE01-A0490 商机管理.创建时间（createdon，空 0%）
LE05-A0295 客户.创建时间（createdon，空 0%）
LE14-A0021 报价申请单.创建时间（createdon，空 0%）
P0-07.physicalFields:
开始：商机.createdon
结束：商机.new_issalesforecast_date
样本去重：商机ID
P0-07.notes: 本次未明确独立的预测创建/更新发起时间，暂保留原“商机创建至预测完成”口径，不声称是独立预测操作耗时。 总体按真实事件去重；缺起止数据与缺字段映射分开列示。分组样本不可直接相加。
P0-07.sqlStatus: 按结果动态判定（见 SQL 中 status 的 CASE）
P0-07.role: 根因判定 / 行动跟踪
P0-07.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → bid_rows → bid_latest → opportunity_flags → node_quote_headers → node_quote_links → node_quote_latest → node_cycle_source → node_cycle_facts → node_cycle_means
P0-07.sql:
-- 指标 P0-07 创建或更新销售预测平均周期：可直接调用 SQL（PostgreSQL 只读；业务表均为 ded_public）
-- 来源：穿透式分析_55种指标_查询_2025_C0及环节周期合并修订.sql 第 28 个指标分支；仅保留该指标依赖的 18 个 CTE，结果与整段执行时该指标的行一致。
-- 修改统计期间：只改 parameters 中的 start_date / end_exclusive（结束日不含）；无绑定参数。
WITH
parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive,
       CURRENT_TIMESTAMP::timestamp AS observed_at,
       ARRAY['1']::text[] AS strategic_levels,
       ARRAY['1','2']::text[] AS focus_levels,
       1000000::numeric AS target_power_units_per_gwh
-- 默认2025全年；结束日不含。仅修改这里，不需要填写绑定参数。
-- 战略客户默认等级1；重点跟踪默认1战略＋2重要。0核心/4BG不自动纳入。
-- 目标power暂沿用当前M0007单项的kWh换算，不用quantity冒充电量。
),
context AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT p.*,LEAST(observed_at,end_exclusive::timestamp) AS cutoff,
       make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1) AS year_start,
       make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer+1,1,1) AS next_year_start,
       GREATEST(0::numeric,LEAST(1::numeric,
        (LEAST(observed_at,end_exclusive::timestamp)::date-make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1))::numeric
        /(make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer+1,1,1)-make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1)))) AS time_progress
FROM parameters p
),
account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT a.accountid::text AS account_id,a.name::text AS account_name,
       a.new_accountlevel::text AS level_code,
       a.new_sapdate::timestamp AS sap_created_at,a.new_sapsubmitdate::timestamp AS sap_submitted_at,
       a.new_approved_time_facreview::timestamp AS account_factory_approved_at,
       a.new_submit_time_facreview::timestamp AS account_factory_submitted_at,
       a.new_sinosurestartdate::timestamp AS account_sinosure_start,
       a.new_sinosureenddate::timestamp AS account_sinosure_end,
       a.new_submit_time_accredit::timestamp AS account_credit_submitted_at,
       a.new_approvaltime_accredit::timestamp AS account_credit_approved_at,
       a.new_cdastartdate::timestamp AS account_cda_start,
       a.new_cdaenddate::timestamp AS account_cda_end,
       a.new_cda_submittime::timestamp AS account_cda_submitted_at,
       a.new_cda_approved_time::timestamp AS account_cda_approved_at,
       a.new_approvalstatus_facreview::text AS account_factory_approval_status,
       a.new_sapcode::text AS sap_code,a.new_issap::text AS sap_registered,
       a.new_issapnew::text AS sap_registration_kind,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY a.accountid ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST,a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb a WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(a.accountid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT account_id,account_name,level_code,sap_created_at,sap_submitted_at,account_factory_approved_at,account_factory_submitted_at,account_sinosure_start,account_sinosure_end,account_credit_submitted_at,account_credit_approved_at,account_cda_start,account_cda_end,account_cda_submitted_at,account_cda_approved_at,account_factory_approval_status,sap_code,sap_registered,sap_registration_kind FROM account_rows WHERE rn=1
),
opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.opportunityid::text AS opportunity_id,o.parentaccountid::text AS account_id,
       o.name::text AS project_name,o.ownerid::text AS owner_id,
       CASE WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯'
            WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS product_type,
       o.new_isqualifiedsuppliers::text AS supplier_flag,
       o.new_istechnologyagreement::text AS technical_flag,
       o.new_iswarranty::text AS warranty_flag,
       o.new_processstage::text AS process_stage,o.statecode::text AS system_state,o.new_demandinput::text AS demand_status,
       o.createdon::timestamp AS created_at,o.new_stage1enddate::timestamp AS s1,
       o.new_stage2enddate::timestamp AS s2,o.new_stage3enddate::timestamp AS s3,
       o.new_stage4enddate::timestamp AS s4,o.new_stage5enddate::timestamp AS s5,
       o.new_cdastartdate::timestamp AS new_cdastartdate,
       o.new_cdaenddate::timestamp AS new_cdaenddate,
       o.new_approved_time_acneed::timestamp AS new_approved_time_acneed,
       o.new_submit_time_acneed::timestamp AS new_submit_time_acneed,
       o.new_issalesforecast_date::timestamp AS new_issalesforecast_date,
       o.new_approved_time_projectassess::timestamp AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
       o.new_submit_time_projectassess::timestamp AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
       o.new_sampletestpass_time::timestamp AS new_sampletestpass_time,
       o.new_sampletime::timestamp AS new_sampletime,
       o.new_technicalsigningdate::timestamp AS new_technicalsigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_techcon::timestamp AS new_submit_time_techcon,
       o.new_warrantysigningdate::timestamp AS new_warrantysigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_qsl::timestamp AS new_submit_time_qsl,
       o.new_isneedcda::text AS new_isneedcda,
       o.new_approvalstatus_acneed::text AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
       o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess::text AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
       o.new_approvalstatus_techcon::text AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
       o.new_approvalstatus_qsl::text AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
       o.new_sampletestresult::text AS new_sampletestresult,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY o.opportunityid ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST,o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb o
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(o.opportunityid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.opportunity_id,o.account_id,o.project_name,o.owner_id,o.product_type,o.process_stage,o.demand_status,
       o.created_at,o.s1,o.s2,o.s3,o.s4,o.s5,a.account_name,a.level_code,
       o.new_cdastartdate,
       o.new_cdaenddate,
       o.new_approved_time_acneed,
       o.new_submit_time_acneed,
       o.new_issalesforecast_date,
       o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
       o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
       o.new_sampletestpass_time,
       o.new_sampletime,
       o.new_technicalsigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_techcon,
       o.new_warrantysigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_qsl,
       o.new_isneedcda,
       o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
       o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
       o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
       o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
       o.new_sampletestresult,a.sap_created_at,a.sap_submitted_at,a.sap_code,a.account_factory_approved_at,a.account_factory_submitted_at,a.account_sinosure_start,a.account_sinosure_end,a.account_credit_submitted_at,a.account_credit_approved_at,a.account_cda_start,a.account_cda_end,a.account_cda_submitted_at,a.account_cda_approved_at,a.account_factory_approval_status
FROM opportunity_rows o LEFT JOIN accounts a USING(account_id) CROSS JOIN context p
WHERE o.rn=1 AND (o.created_at IS NULL OR o.created_at<=p.cutoff)
),
orders AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT salesorderid::text AS order_id
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(salesorderid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
-- 签单严格按“有关联订单”确认：不使用订单头opportunityid，也不使用合同确认枚举。
-- 未额外限定审批、取消状态或订单日期；本查询统计的是关联关系现状，不是历史签单快照。
),
order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT l.new_opportunity_id::text AS opportunity_id,l.salesorderid::text AS order_id
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb l
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(l.new_opportunity_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(BTRIM(l.salesorderid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT l.opportunity_id,COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
FROM order_line_links l JOIN orders o USING(order_id) GROUP BY l.opportunity_id
),
bid_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT b.project_name::text AS project_name,b.seq_no::text AS bid_id,b.seq_no AS bid_seq,b.remark::text AS remark,
       NULLIF(BTRIM(b.input_time::text),'')::timestamp AS input_at,
       NULLIF(BTRIM(b.bid_open_time::text),'')::timestamp AS open_at,
       NULLIF(BTRIM(b.winner_announce_time::text),'')::timestamp AS result_at
FROM ded_public.p_fm_bid_project_info b
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(b.project_name::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
bid_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT project_name,bid_id,remark,input_at,result_at FROM (
 SELECT b.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY project_name ORDER BY input_at DESC NULLS LAST,bid_seq DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
 FROM bid_rows b CROSS JOIN context p WHERE b.input_at IS NOT NULL AND b.input_at<=p.cutoff
) r WHERE rn=1
),
opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.*,COALESCE(s.order_count,0) AS order_count,COALESCE(s.order_count,0)>0 AS signed,
       b.project_name IS NOT NULL AS entered_bid,
       b.project_name IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(b.remark,'') NOT LIKE '%弃标%'
          AND (b.result_at IS NULL OR b.result_at>p.cutoff) AS bidding,
       b.bid_id,b.input_at,b.result_at
FROM opportunities o LEFT JOIN signed_orders s USING(opportunity_id)
LEFT JOIN bid_latest b ON b.project_name=o.project_name CROSS JOIN context p
),
node_quote_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT q.new_quoteapplyid::text AS quote_id,q.createdon::timestamp AS created_at,
 q.new_oasubmitdate::timestamp AS submitted_at,q.new_approved_time::timestamp AS approved_at,
 q.new_approvalstatus::text AS approval_status
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapply_esb q
WHERE q.new_quoteapplyid IS NOT NULL
),
node_quote_links AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT d.new_opportunity_id::text AS opportunity_id,d.new_quoteapply_id::text AS quote_id
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapplydetail_esb d
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(d.new_opportunity_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL
 AND NULLIF(BTRIM(d.new_quoteapply_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
node_quote_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT opportunity_id,quote_id,submitted_at,approved_at,approval_status FROM (
 SELECT o.opportunity_id,q.quote_id,q.submitted_at,q.approved_at,q.approval_status,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY o.opportunity_id ORDER BY q.created_at DESC NULLS LAST,q.quote_id DESC) AS rn
 FROM opportunity_flags o JOIN node_quote_links l USING(opportunity_id)
 JOIN node_quote_headers q USING(quote_id) CROSS JOIN context p
 WHERE q.created_at<=p.cutoff

) ranked WHERE rn=1
),
node_cycle_source AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.opportunity_id,o.product_type,n.metric_code,n.phase_code,n.started_at,
 n.finished_at,n.entered_at,n.active_flag,n.event_id,
 n.started_at>=p.start_date AND n.started_at<p.end_exclusive AND n.started_at<=p.cutoff AS in_window,
 p.cutoff
FROM opportunity_flags o LEFT JOIN node_quote_latest q USING(opportunity_id)
CROSS JOIN context p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
('P0-03'::text,'P0'::text,o.new_cdastartdate,o.new_cdaenddate,o.new_cdastartdate,COALESCE((o.new_isneedcda='2'),FALSE),(o.opportunity_id)::text),
('P0-04'::text,'P0'::text,o.new_submit_time_acneed,o.new_approved_time_acneed,o.new_submit_time_acneed,COALESCE((o.new_approvalstatus_acneed='2'),FALSE),(o.opportunity_id)::text),
('P0-06'::text,'P0'::text,o.new_submit_time_acneed,o.new_approved_time_acneed,o.new_submit_time_acneed,COALESCE((o.new_approvalstatus_acneed='2'),FALSE),(o.opportunity_id)::text),
('P0-07'::text,'P0'::text,o.created_at,o.new_issalesforecast_date,NULL::timestamp,COALESCE((FALSE),FALSE),(o.opportunity_id)::text),
('P1-03'::text,'P1'::text,o.account_factory_submitted_at,o.account_factory_approved_at,o.account_factory_submitted_at,COALESCE((o.account_factory_approval_status='2'),FALSE),(o.account_id)::text),
('P1-04'::text,'P1'::text,o.new_submit_time_projectassess,o.new_approved_time_projectassess,o.new_submit_time_projectassess,COALESCE((o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess='2'),FALSE),(o.opportunity_id)::text),
('P1-05'::text,'P1'::text,o.new_sampletime,o.new_sampletestpass_time,o.new_sampletime,COALESCE((o.new_sampletestresult IS NULL),FALSE),(o.opportunity_id)::text),
('P1-07'::text,'P1'::text,q.submitted_at,CASE WHEN q.approval_status='3' THEN q.approved_at END,q.submitted_at,COALESCE((q.approval_status='2'),FALSE),(q.quote_id)::text),
('P2-03'::text,'P2'::text,o.new_submit_time_techcon,o.new_technicalsigningdate,o.new_submit_time_techcon,COALESCE((o.new_approvalstatus_techcon='2'),FALSE),(o.opportunity_id)::text),
('P2-04'::text,'P2'::text,o.new_submit_time_qsl,o.new_warrantysigningdate,o.new_submit_time_qsl,COALESCE((o.new_approvalstatus_qsl='2'),FALSE),(o.opportunity_id)::text)
) n(metric_code,phase_code,started_at,finished_at,entered_at,active_flag,event_id)
-- 小环节按自身起止；不以当前阶段枚举限定已经历的环节。
-- P0-07未确认独立发起日期，本次保留原累计创建至完成口径并明确标注。
-- P3-03/P3-05按用户指令暂不计算，不读取其完成字段来拼接阶段起点。
),
node_cycle_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT f.*,
 CASE WHEN in_window AND event_id IS NOT NULL AND finished_at>=started_at AND finished_at<=cutoff
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (finished_at-started_at))/86400::numeric
      WHEN in_window AND event_id IS NOT NULL AND entered_at IS NOT NULL AND entered_at<=cutoff
        AND (finished_at>cutoff OR (finished_at IS NULL AND active_flag))
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (cutoff-started_at))/86400::numeric END AS duration_days,
 in_window AND event_id IS NOT NULL AND finished_at>=started_at AND finished_at<=cutoff AS completed_valid,
 in_window AND event_id IS NOT NULL AND entered_at IS NOT NULL AND entered_at<=cutoff
  AND (finished_at>cutoff OR (finished_at IS NULL AND active_flag)) AS inflight_valid
FROM node_cycle_source f
-- 完成值早于真实开始时不取ABS或0；无法确认仍在途的缺失完成日期不以当前时间补齐。
),
node_cycle_means AS MATERIALIZED (
WITH event_samples AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT metric_code,product_type,event_id,duration_days,completed_valid,inflight_valid
 FROM node_cycle_facts WHERE duration_days IS NOT NULL
 UNION ALL
 SELECT DISTINCT metric_code,'全部'::text AS product_type,event_id,duration_days,completed_valid,inflight_valid
 FROM node_cycle_facts WHERE duration_days IS NOT NULL
), sample_stats AS (
 SELECT metric_code,product_type,COUNT(*) AS sample_count,AVG(duration_days) AS mean_days,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE completed_valid) AS completed_count,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE inflight_valid) AS inflight_count
 FROM event_samples GROUP BY metric_code,product_type
), quality AS (
 SELECT metric_code,CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type)=1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
 COUNT(*) AS linked_source_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE in_window) AS entry_window_rows,
 COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) FILTER(WHERE in_window) AS entered_event_count,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE in_window AND finished_at IS NULL) AS missing_end_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE started_at IS NULL) AS missing_start_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE event_id IS NULL) AS missing_event_id_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE in_window AND finished_at<started_at) AS end_before_start_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE in_window AND finished_at>cutoff AND NOT COALESCE(inflight_valid,FALSE)) AS future_end_without_entry_proof_rows,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE in_window AND finished_at IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(inflight_valid,FALSE)) AS unknown_completion_rows
 FROM node_cycle_facts GROUP BY metric_code,GROUPING SETS((),(product_type))
)
SELECT q.*,COALESCE(s.sample_count,0) AS sample_count,s.mean_days,
 COALESCE(s.completed_count,0) AS completed_count,COALESCE(s.inflight_count,0) AS inflight_count
FROM quality q LEFT JOIN sample_stats s USING(metric_code,product_type)
-- 同一事件可出现在多个产品分组；各分组样本数不可相加当总体，总体已单独按事件去重。
),
metric_results AS (
SELECT 28 AS sort_no,'P0-07'::text AS code,'创建或更新销售预测平均周期'::text AS metric_name,
NULL::text AS product_team,NULL::numeric AS amount_yi,NULL::numeric AS energy_gwh,
n.sample_count::bigint AS item_count,NULL::numeric AS ratio_value,n.mean_days::numeric AS days_value,
CASE WHEN n.sample_count>0 THEN '暂沿用创建至预测完成；独立发起时间待补'
 WHEN COALESCE(n.entry_window_rows,0)=0 THEN '已映射；起始时间缺失或不在所选窗口'
 ELSE '已映射；没有有效起止配对，原因见明细' END::text AS status,
'暂沿用商机.createdon至商机.new_issalesforecast_date的累计耗时，尚未获得独立的预测创建/更新发起时间；不当作独立预测操作耗时。 本次未明确独立的预测创建/更新发起时间，暂保留原“商机创建至预测完成”口径，不声称是独立预测操作耗时。 总体按真实事件去重；缺起止数据与缺字段映射分开列示。分组样本不可直接相加。'::text AS note,
(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM node_cycle_means x WHERE x.metric_code='P0-07') AS detail
FROM context p LEFT JOIN node_cycle_means n ON n.metric_code='P0-07' AND n.product_type='全部'
)
SELECT r.code AS "指标序号",r.metric_name AS "指标名称",r.product_team AS "产品团队",
p.start_date AS "期间开始",p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",r.item_count AS "数量",
r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
CASE WHEN r.status='查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' THEN
 CASE WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
        OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围' END ELSE r.status END AS "计算说明状态",
r.note AS "取值说明",r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results r CROSS JOIN context p ORDER BY r.sort_no,r.product_team NULLS LAST;;

P0-08.name: 确认客户组织架构平均周期

P0-08.formula: 单笔实际周期严格大于对应动态平均周期的 1.5 倍时判为超期风险。
P0-08.physicalFields:
本环节独立开始：待明确
本环节独立完成：待明确
P0-08.notes: 时间字段存在与完成事件已映射需区分。已有组织架构状态new_accountorganization，尚未明确组织架构确认完成时间。 本次统一为自身起止原则，未再借阶段起点计算。
P0-08.sqlStatus: 未明确本环节完成事件映射，暂留NULL
P0-08.sql:
-- 指标 P0-08 确认客户组织架构平均周期：可直接调用 SQL（PostgreSQL 只读；业务表均为 ded_public）
-- 来源：穿透式分析_55种指标_查询_2025_C0及环节周期合并修订.sql 第 29 个指标分支；仅保留该指标依赖的 2 个 CTE，结果与整段执行时该指标的行一致。
-- 修改统计期间：只改 parameters 中的 start_date / end_exclusive（结束日不含）；无绑定参数。
WITH
parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive,
       CURRENT_TIMESTAMP::timestamp AS observed_at,
       ARRAY['1']::text[] AS strategic_levels,
       ARRAY['1','2']::text[] AS focus_levels,
       1000000::numeric AS target_power_units_per_gwh
-- 默认2025全年；结束日不含。仅修改这里，不需要填写绑定参数。
-- 战略客户默认等级1；重点跟踪默认1战略＋2重要。0核心/4BG不自动纳入。
-- 目标power暂沿用当前M0007单项的kWh换算，不用quantity冒充电量。
),
context AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT p.*,LEAST(observed_at,end_exclusive::timestamp) AS cutoff,
       make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1) AS year_start,
       make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer+1,1,1) AS next_year_start,
       GREATEST(0::numeric,LEAST(1::numeric,
        (LEAST(observed_at,end_exclusive::timestamp)::date-make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1))::numeric
        /(make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer+1,1,1)-make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1)))) AS time_progress
FROM parameters p
),
metric_results AS (
SELECT 29 AS sort_no,'P0-08'::text AS code,'确认客户组织架构平均周期'::text AS metric_name,
NULL::text AS product_team,
(NULL)::numeric AS amount_yi,(NULL)::numeric AS energy_gwh,(NULL)::bigint AS item_count,
(NULL)::numeric AS ratio_value,(NULL)::numeric AS days_value,'未明确本环节完成事件映射，暂留NULL'::text AS status,
'已有组织架构状态new_accountorganization，尚未明确组织架构确认完成时间。'::text AS note,(NULL)::jsonb AS detail
)
SELECT r.code AS "指标序号",r.metric_name AS "指标名称",r.product_team AS "产品团队",
p.start_date AS "期间开始",p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",r.item_count AS "数量",
r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
CASE WHEN r.status='查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' THEN
 CASE WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
        OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围' END ELSE r.status END AS "计算说明状态",
r.note AS "取值说明",r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results r CROSS JOIN context p ORDER BY r.sort_no,r.product_team NULLS LAST;;

P1-01.name: 技术交流阶段平均周期
P1-01.definition: 统计所有实际经历过P1阶段的商机，不按当前new_processstage限定样本。当前已进入后续阶段的商机也纳入。按商机.new_stage1enddate至new_stage2enddate计算；已完成取结束，在途取观察截止，按电芯/PACK分别计算动态均值。统计窗口以进入本阶段时间归期。
P1-01.formula: 单笔实际周期严格大于对应动态平均周期的 1.5 倍时判为超期风险。
P1-01.attributes:
LE01-A0101 商机管理.阶段一结束日期（new_stage1enddate，空 63.04%）
LE01-A0243 商机管理.阶段二结束日期（new_stage2enddate，空 66.19%）
LE01-A0451 商机管理.项目阶段（new_processstage，空 0%）
P1-01.physicalFields: 商机.new_stage1enddate→new_stage2enddate；不要求当前new_processstage为本阶段枚举
P1-01.notes: 与C01的“当前处于P0”条件区分；阶段平均周期不加当前阶段枚举过滤。缺少有效日期的记录不能仅凭后续阶段枚举补造日期。
P1-01.sqlStatus: 查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细
P1-01.role: 跨阶段参考（不参与本节点链路）
P1-01.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → bid_rows → bid_latest → opportunity_flags → stage_facts → stage_means
P1-01.sql:
-- 指标 P1-01 技术交流阶段平均周期：可直接调用 SQL（PostgreSQL 只读；业务表均为 ded_public）
-- 来源：穿透式分析_55种指标_查询_2025_C0及环节周期合并修订.sql 第 30 个指标分支；仅保留该指标依赖的 14 个 CTE，结果与整段执行时该指标的行一致。
-- 修改统计期间：只改 parameters 中的 start_date / end_exclusive（结束日不含）；无绑定参数。
WITH
parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive,
       CURRENT_TIMESTAMP::timestamp AS observed_at,
       ARRAY['1']::text[] AS strategic_levels,
       ARRAY['1','2']::text[] AS focus_levels,
       1000000::numeric AS target_power_units_per_gwh
-- 默认2025全年；结束日不含。仅修改这里，不需要填写绑定参数。
-- 战略客户默认等级1；重点跟踪默认1战略＋2重要。0核心/4BG不自动纳入。
-- 目标power暂沿用当前M0007单项的kWh换算，不用quantity冒充电量。
),
context AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT p.*,LEAST(observed_at,end_exclusive::timestamp) AS cutoff,
       make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1) AS year_start,
       make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer+1,1,1) AS next_year_start,
       GREATEST(0::numeric,LEAST(1::numeric,
        (LEAST(observed_at,end_exclusive::timestamp)::date-make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1))::numeric
        /(make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer+1,1,1)-make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1)))) AS time_progress
FROM parameters p
),
account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT a.accountid::text AS account_id,a.name::text AS account_name,
       a.new_accountlevel::text AS level_code,
       a.new_sapdate::timestamp AS sap_created_at,a.new_sapsubmitdate::timestamp AS sap_submitted_at,
       a.new_approved_time_facreview::timestamp AS account_factory_approved_at,
       a.new_submit_time_facreview::timestamp AS account_factory_submitted_at,
       a.new_sinosurestartdate::timestamp AS account_sinosure_start,
       a.new_sinosureenddate::timestamp AS account_sinosure_end,
       a.new_submit_time_accredit::timestamp AS account_credit_submitted_at,
       a.new_approvaltime_accredit::timestamp AS account_credit_approved_at,
       a.new_cdastartdate::timestamp AS account_cda_start,
       a.new_cdaenddate::timestamp AS account_cda_end,
       a.new_cda_submittime::timestamp AS account_cda_submitted_at,
       a.new_cda_approved_time::timestamp AS account_cda_approved_at,
       a.new_approvalstatus_facreview::text AS account_factory_approval_status,
       a.new_sapcode::text AS sap_code,a.new_issap::text AS sap_registered,
       a.new_issapnew::text AS sap_registration_kind,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY a.accountid ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST,a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb a WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(a.accountid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT account_id,account_name,level_code,sap_created_at,sap_submitted_at,account_factory_approved_at,account_factory_submitted_at,account_sinosure_start,account_sinosure_end,account_credit_submitted_at,account_credit_approved_at,account_cda_start,account_cda_end,account_cda_submitted_at,account_cda_approved_at,account_factory_approval_status,sap_code,sap_registered,sap_registration_kind FROM account_rows WHERE rn=1
),
opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.opportunityid::text AS opportunity_id,o.parentaccountid::text AS account_id,
       o.name::text AS project_name,o.ownerid::text AS owner_id,
       CASE WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯'
            WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS product_type,
       o.new_isqualifiedsuppliers::text AS supplier_flag,
       o.new_istechnologyagreement::text AS technical_flag,
       o.new_iswarranty::text AS warranty_flag,
       o.new_processstage::text AS process_stage,o.statecode::text AS system_state,o.new_demandinput::text AS demand_status,
       o.createdon::timestamp AS created_at,o.new_stage1enddate::timestamp AS s1,
       o.new_stage2enddate::timestamp AS s2,o.new_stage3enddate::timestamp AS s3,
       o.new_stage4enddate::timestamp AS s4,o.new_stage5enddate::timestamp AS s5,
       o.new_cdastartdate::timestamp AS new_cdastartdate,
       o.new_cdaenddate::timestamp AS new_cdaenddate,
       o.new_approved_time_acneed::timestamp AS new_approved_time_acneed,
       o.new_submit_time_acneed::timestamp AS new_submit_time_acneed,
       o.new_issalesforecast_date::timestamp AS new_issalesforecast_date,
       o.new_approved_time_projectassess::timestamp AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
       o.new_submit_time_projectassess::timestamp AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
       o.new_sampletestpass_time::timestamp AS new_sampletestpass_time,
       o.new_sampletime::timestamp AS new_sampletime,
       o.new_technicalsigningdate::timestamp AS new_technicalsigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_techcon::timestamp AS new_submit_time_techcon,
       o.new_warrantysigningdate::timestamp AS new_warrantysigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_qsl::timestamp AS new_submit_time_qsl,
       o.new_isneedcda::text AS new_isneedcda,
       o.new_approvalstatus_acneed::text AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
       o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess::text AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
       o.new_approvalstatus_techcon::text AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
       o.new_approvalstatus_qsl::text AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
       o.new_sampletestresult::text AS new_sampletestresult,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY o.opportunityid ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST,o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb o
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(o.opportunityid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.opportunity_id,o.account_id,o.project_name,o.owner_id,o.product_type,o.process_stage,o.demand_status,
       o.created_at,o.s1,o.s2,o.s3,o.s4,o.s5,a.account_name,a.level_code,
       o.new_cdastartdate,
       o.new_cdaenddate,
       o.new_approved_time_acneed,
       o.new_submit_time_acneed,
       o.new_issalesforecast_date,
       o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
       o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
       o.new_sampletestpass_time,
       o.new_sampletime,
       o.new_technicalsigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_techcon,
       o.new_warrantysigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_qsl,
       o.new_isneedcda,
       o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
       o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
       o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
       o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
       o.new_sampletestresult,a.sap_created_at,a.sap_submitted_at,a.sap_code,a.account_factory_approved_at,a.account_factory_submitted_at,a.account_sinosure_start,a.account_sinosure_end,a.account_credit_submitted_at,a.account_credit_approved_at,a.account_cda_start,a.account_cda_end,a.account_cda_submitted_at,a.account_cda_approved_at,a.account_factory_approval_status
FROM opportunity_rows o LEFT JOIN accounts a USING(account_id) CROSS JOIN context p
WHERE o.rn=1 AND (o.created_at IS NULL OR o.created_at<=p.cutoff)
),
orders AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT salesorderid::text AS order_id
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(salesorderid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
-- 签单严格按“有关联订单”确认：不使用订单头opportunityid，也不使用合同确认枚举。
-- 未额外限定审批、取消状态或订单日期；本查询统计的是关联关系现状，不是历史签单快照。
),
order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT l.new_opportunity_id::text AS opportunity_id,l.salesorderid::text AS order_id
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb l
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(l.new_opportunity_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(BTRIM(l.salesorderid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT l.opportunity_id,COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
FROM order_line_links l JOIN orders o USING(order_id) GROUP BY l.opportunity_id
),
bid_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT b.project_name::text AS project_name,b.seq_no::text AS bid_id,b.seq_no AS bid_seq,b.remark::text AS remark,
       NULLIF(BTRIM(b.input_time::text),'')::timestamp AS input_at,
       NULLIF(BTRIM(b.bid_open_time::text),'')::timestamp AS open_at,
       NULLIF(BTRIM(b.winner_announce_time::text),'')::timestamp AS result_at
FROM ded_public.p_fm_bid_project_info b
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(b.project_name::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
bid_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT project_name,bid_id,remark,input_at,result_at FROM (
 SELECT b.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY project_name ORDER BY input_at DESC NULLS LAST,bid_seq DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
 FROM bid_rows b CROSS JOIN context p WHERE b.input_at IS NOT NULL AND b.input_at<=p.cutoff
) r WHERE rn=1
),
opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.*,COALESCE(s.order_count,0) AS order_count,COALESCE(s.order_count,0)>0 AS signed,
       b.project_name IS NOT NULL AS entered_bid,
       b.project_name IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(b.remark,'') NOT LIKE '%弃标%'
          AND (b.result_at IS NULL OR b.result_at>p.cutoff) AS bidding,
       b.bid_id,b.input_at,b.result_at
FROM opportunities o LEFT JOIN signed_orders s USING(opportunity_id)
LEFT JOIN bid_latest b ON b.project_name=o.project_name CROSS JOIN context p
),
stage_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.*,v.stage_code,v.started_at,v.finished_at,
       (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (LEAST(COALESCE(v.finished_at,p.cutoff),p.cutoff)-v.started_at))/86400::numeric) AS elapsed_days,
       v.started_at>=p.start_date AND v.started_at<p.end_exclusive AS in_window,
       v.finished_at IS NULL OR v.finished_at>p.cutoff AS inflight,
       v.started_at IS NULL OR (v.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND v.finished_at<v.started_at) AS invalid_dates
FROM opportunity_flags o CROSS JOIN context p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
 ('P0',o.created_at,o.s1),('P1',o.s1,o.s2),('P2',o.s2,o.s3),('P3',o.s3,o.s4),('P4',o.s4,o.s5)
) v(stage_code,started_at,finished_at)
WHERE v.started_at IS NOT NULL AND v.started_at<=p.cutoff
-- 不是“当前阶段枚举＝某值”才入均值；已进入该阶段且已完成/仍在途的样本都参与。
-- 日期逆序剔除并计数；在途截至所选期末与观察日中的较早者。
),
stage_means AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT stage_code,product_type,AVG(elapsed_days) FILTER(WHERE NOT invalid_dates) AS mean_days,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT invalid_dates) AS sample_count,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE invalid_dates) AS invalid_count,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE inflight AND NOT invalid_dates) AS inflight_count
FROM stage_facts WHERE in_window GROUP BY stage_code,product_type
),
metric_results AS (
SELECT 30 AS sort_no,'P1-01'::text AS code,'技术交流阶段平均周期'::text AS metric_name,
NULL::text AS product_team,
(NULL)::numeric AS amount_yi,(NULL)::numeric AS energy_gwh,(COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT invalid_dates))::bigint AS item_count,
(NULL)::numeric AS ratio_value,(AVG(elapsed_days) FILTER(WHERE NOT invalid_dates))::numeric AS days_value,'查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'::text AS status,
'new_stage1enddate→new_stage2enddate；已进入该阶段的已完成＋在途。主值为总体均值，实际超期阈值按明细内电芯/PACK均值。'::text AS note,((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t)) FROM stage_means t WHERE stage_code='P1'))::jsonb AS detail
FROM stage_facts f WHERE stage_code='P1' AND in_window
)
SELECT r.code AS "指标序号",r.metric_name AS "指标名称",r.product_team AS "产品团队",
p.start_date AS "期间开始",p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",r.item_count AS "数量",
r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
CASE WHEN r.status='查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' THEN
 CASE WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
        OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围' END ELSE r.status END AS "计算说明状态",
r.note AS "取值说明",r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results r CROSS JOIN context p ORDER BY r.sort_no,r.product_team NULLS LAST;;

P1-02.name: 技术交流阶段超过平均周期 50% 的商机预测总量
P1-02.definition: 按阶段筛出实际周期大于动态平均周期 1.5 倍的商机。以商机 ID 去重后汇总预测金额和电量，细分电芯与 PACK。
P1-02.formula: 只汇总本阶段满足超期条件的商机。同一商机在同一阶段只计算一次。
P1-02.attributes:
LE01-A0101 商机管理.阶段一结束日期（new_stage1enddate，空 63.04%）
LE01-A0243 商机管理.阶段二结束日期（new_stage2enddate，空 66.19%）
LE01-A0451 商机管理.项目阶段（new_processstage，空 0%）
P1-02.notes: 阶段均值包含已完成及在途；超过均值1.5倍预测量需另算。当前看板无同名完整查询。
P1-02.sqlStatus: 查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细
P1-02.role: 跨阶段参考（不参与本节点链路）
P1-02.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → bid_rows → bid_latest → opportunity_flags → forecast_rows → forecast_facts → opportunity_forecast → stage_facts → stage_means → stage_overdue
P1-02.sql:
-- 指标 P1-02 技术交流阶段超过平均周期 50% 的商机预测总量：可直接调用 SQL（PostgreSQL 只读；业务表均为 ded_public）
-- 来源：穿透式分析_55种指标_查询_2025_C0及环节周期合并修订.sql 第 31 个指标分支；仅保留该指标依赖的 18 个 CTE，结果与整段执行时该指标的行一致。
-- 修改统计期间：只改 parameters 中的 start_date / end_exclusive（结束日不含）；无绑定参数。
WITH
parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-01-01' AS end_exclusive,
       CURRENT_TIMESTAMP::timestamp AS observed_at,
       ARRAY['1']::text[] AS strategic_levels,
       ARRAY['1','2']::text[] AS focus_levels,
       1000000::numeric AS target_power_units_per_gwh
-- 默认2025全年；结束日不含。仅修改这里，不需要填写绑定参数。
-- 战略客户默认等级1；重点跟踪默认1战略＋2重要。0核心/4BG不自动纳入。
-- 目标power暂沿用当前M0007单项的kWh换算，不用quantity冒充电量。
),
context AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT p.*,LEAST(observed_at,end_exclusive::timestamp) AS cutoff,
       make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1) AS year_start,
       make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer+1,1,1) AS next_year_start,
       GREATEST(0::numeric,LEAST(1::numeric,
        (LEAST(observed_at,end_exclusive::timestamp)::date-make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1))::numeric
        /(make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer+1,1,1)-make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1)))) AS time_progress
FROM parameters p
),
account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT a.accountid::text AS account_id,a.name::text AS account_name,
       a.new_accountlevel::text AS level_code,
       a.new_sapdate::timestamp AS sap_created_at,a.new_sapsubmitdate::timestamp AS sap_submitted_at,
       a.new_approved_time_facreview::timestamp AS account_factory_approved_at,
       a.new_submit_time_facreview::timestamp AS account_factory_submitted_at,
       a.new_sinosurestartdate::timestamp AS account_sinosure_start,
       a.new_sinosureenddate::timestamp AS account_sinosure_end,
       a.new_submit_time_accredit::timestamp AS account_credit_submitted_at,
       a.new_approvaltime_accredit::timestamp AS account_credit_approved_at,
       a.new_cdastartdate::timestamp AS account_cda_start,
       a.new_cdaenddate::timestamp AS account_cda_end,
       a.new_cda_submittime::timestamp AS account_cda_submitted_at,
       a.new_cda_approved_time::timestamp AS account_cda_approved_at,
       a.new_approvalstatus_facreview::text AS account_factory_approval_status,
       a.new_sapcode::text AS sap_code,a.new_issap::text AS sap_registered,
       a.new_issapnew::text AS sap_registration_kind,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY a.accountid ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST,a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb a WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(a.accountid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT account_id,account_name,level_code,sap_created_at,sap_submitted_at,account_factory_approved_at,account_factory_submitted_at,account_sinosure_start,account_sinosure_end,account_credit_submitted_at,account_credit_approved_at,account_cda_start,account_cda_end,account_cda_submitted_at,account_cda_approved_at,account_factory_approval_status,sap_code,sap_registered,sap_registration_kind FROM account_rows WHERE rn=1
),
opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.opportunityid::text AS opportunity_id,o.parentaccountid::text AS account_id,
       o.name::text AS project_name,o.ownerid::text AS owner_id,
       CASE WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('1','电芯') THEN '电芯'
            WHEN o.new_accproducttype::text IN ('2','PACK') THEN 'PACK' ELSE '其他' END AS product_type,
       o.new_isqualifiedsuppliers::text AS supplier_flag,
       o.new_istechnologyagreement::text AS technical_flag,
       o.new_iswarranty::text AS warranty_flag,
       o.new_processstage::text AS process_stage,o.statecode::text AS system_state,o.new_demandinput::text AS demand_status,
       o.createdon::timestamp AS created_at,o.new_stage1enddate::timestamp AS s1,
       o.new_stage2enddate::timestamp AS s2,o.new_stage3enddate::timestamp AS s3,
       o.new_stage4enddate::timestamp AS s4,o.new_stage5enddate::timestamp AS s5,
       o.new_cdastartdate::timestamp AS new_cdastartdate,
       o.new_cdaenddate::timestamp AS new_cdaenddate,
       o.new_approved_time_acneed::timestamp AS new_approved_time_acneed,
       o.new_submit_time_acneed::timestamp AS new_submit_time_acneed,
       o.new_issalesforecast_date::timestamp AS new_issalesforecast_date,
       o.new_approved_time_projectassess::timestamp AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
       o.new_submit_time_projectassess::timestamp AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
       o.new_sampletestpass_time::timestamp AS new_sampletestpass_time,
       o.new_sampletime::timestamp AS new_sampletime,
       o.new_technicalsigningdate::timestamp AS new_technicalsigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_techcon::timestamp AS new_submit_time_techcon,
       o.new_warrantysigningdate::timestamp AS new_warrantysigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_qsl::timestamp AS new_submit_time_qsl,
       o.new_isneedcda::text AS new_isneedcda,
       o.new_approvalstatus_acneed::text AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
       o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess::text AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
       o.new_approvalstatus_techcon::text AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
       o.new_approvalstatus_qsl::text AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
       o.new_sampletestresult::text AS new_sampletestresult,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY o.opportunityid ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST,o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb o
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(o.opportunityid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.opportunity_id,o.account_id,o.project_name,o.owner_id,o.product_type,o.process_stage,o.demand_status,
       o.created_at,o.s1,o.s2,o.s3,o.s4,o.s5,a.account_name,a.level_code,
       o.new_cdastartdate,
       o.new_cdaenddate,
       o.new_approved_time_acneed,
       o.new_submit_time_acneed,
       o.new_issalesforecast_date,
       o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
       o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
       o.new_sampletestpass_time,
       o.new_sampletime,
       o.new_technicalsigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_techcon,
       o.new_warrantysigningdate,
       o.new_submit_time_qsl,
       o.new_isneedcda,
       o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
       o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
       o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
       o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
       o.new_sampletestresult,a.sap_created_at,a.sap_submitted_at,a.sap_code,a.account_factory_approved_at,a.account_factory_submitted_at,a.account_sinosure_start,a.account_sinosure_end,a.account_credit_submitted_at,a.account_credit_approved_at,a.account_cda_start,a.account_cda_end,a.account_cda_submitted_at,a.account_cda_approved_at,a.account_factory_approval_status
FROM opportunity_rows o LEFT JOIN accounts a USING(account_id) CROSS JOIN context p
WHERE o.rn=1 AND (o.created_at IS NULL OR o.created_at<=p.cutoff)
),
orders AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT salesorderid::text AS order_id
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(salesorderid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
-- 签单严格按“有关联订单”确认：不使用订单头opportunityid，也不使用合同确认枚举。
-- 未额外限定审批、取消状态或订单日期；本查询统计的是关联关系现状，不是历史签单快照。
),
order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT l.new_opportunity_id::text AS opportunity_id,l.salesorderid::text AS order_id
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb l
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(l.new_opportunity_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(BTRIM(l.salesorderid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT l.opportunity_id,COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
FROM order_line_links l JOIN orders o USING(order_id) GROUP BY l.opportunity_id
),
bid_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT b.project_name::text AS project_name,b.seq_no::text AS bid_id,b.seq_no AS bid_seq,b.remark::text AS remark,
       NULLIF(BTRIM(b.input_time::text),'')::timestamp AS input_at,
       NULLIF(BTRIM(b.bid_open_time::text),'')::timestamp AS open_at,
       NULLIF(BTRIM(b.winner_announce_time::text),'')::timestamp AS result_at
FROM ded_public.p_fm_bid_project_info b
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(b.project_name::text),'') IS NOT NULL
),
bid_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT project_name,bid_id,remark,input_at,result_at FROM (
 SELECT b.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY project_name ORDER BY input_at DESC NULLS LAST,bid_seq DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
 FROM bid_rows b CROSS JOIN context p WHERE b.input_at IS NOT NULL AND b.input_at<=p.cutoff
) r WHERE rn=1
),
opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.*,COALESCE(s.order_count,0) AS order_count,COALESCE(s.order_count,0)>0 AS signed,
       b.project_name IS NOT NULL AS entered_bid,
       b.project_name IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(b.remark,'') NOT LIKE '%弃标%'
          AND (b.result_at IS NULL OR b.result_at>p.cutoff) AS bidding,
       b.bid_id,b.input_at,b.result_at
FROM opportunities o LEFT JOIN signed_orders s USING(opportunity_id)
LEFT JOIN bid_latest b ON b.project_name=o.project_name CROSS JOIN context p
),
forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT m.new_oppmonthid::text AS forecast_id,m.new_opportunity_id::text AS opportunity_id,
       m.new_accountdate::timestamp AS forecast_month,m.new_forecast_amt_rmb::numeric AS amount_yuan,
       m.new_whprice::numeric AS wh_price,
       ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id,date_trunc('month',m.new_accountdate::timestamp)
        ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST,m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST,m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb m CROSS JOIN context p
WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(m.new_oppmonthid::text),'') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(BTRIM(m.new_opportunity_id::text),'') IS NOT NULL
  AND m.new_accountdate::timestamp>=p.start_date AND m.new_accountdate::timestamp<p.end_exclusive
-- 月度事实：同商机同月按创建/修改时间取最新；不是全年每商机只留一个月份。
-- 商机预测金额直接用new_forecast_amt_rmb，不混用实际销售额。
-- 原穿透Excel/阶段TXT未另给审核状态范围，此查询不附加审核/业务状态过滤。
),
forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT f.forecast_id,f.forecast_month,o.*,
       f.amount_yuan/100000000::numeric AS amount_yi,
       f.amount_yuan/NULLIF(f.wh_price,0)/1000000000::numeric AS energy_gwh
FROM forecast_rows f JOIN opportunity_flags o USING(opportunity_id) WHERE f.rn=1
-- new_whprice沿用现有商机指标的元/Wh口径；金额÷单价得到Wh，再÷10^9转GWh。
),
opportunity_forecast AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT opportunity_id,COUNT(*) AS forecast_rows,SUM(amount_yi) AS amount_yi,SUM(energy_gwh) AS energy_gwh,
       COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
       COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
FROM forecast_facts GROUP BY opportunity_id
),
stage_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT o.*,v.stage_code,v.started_at,v.finished_at,
       (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (LEAST(COALESCE(v.finished_at,p.cutoff),p.cutoff)-v.started_at))/86400::numeric) AS elapsed_days,
       v.started_at>=p.start_date AND v.started_at<p.end_exclusive AS in_window,
       v.finished_at IS NULL OR v.finished_at>p.cutoff AS inflight,
       v.started_at IS NULL OR (v.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND v.finished_at<v.started_at) AS invalid_dates
FROM opportunity_flags o CROSS JOIN context p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
 ('P0',o.created_at,o.s1),('P1',o.s1,o.s2),('P2',o.s2,o.s3),('P3',o.s3,o.s4),('P4',o.s4,o.s5)
) v(stage_code,started_at,finished_at)
WHERE v.started_at IS NOT NULL AND v.started_at<=p.cutoff
-- 不是“当前阶段枚举＝某值”才入均值；已进入该阶段且已完成/仍在途的样本都参与。
-- 日期逆序剔除并计数；在途截至所选期末与观察日中的较早者。
),
stage_means AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT stage_code,product_type,AVG(elapsed_days) FILTER(WHERE NOT invalid_dates) AS mean_days,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT invalid_dates) AS sample_count,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE invalid_dates) AS invalid_count,
 COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE inflight AND NOT invalid_dates) AS inflight_count
FROM stage_facts WHERE in_window GROUP BY stage_code,product_type
),
stage_overdue AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT f.*,m.mean_days,ofc.amount_yi,ofc.energy_gwh,
       f.elapsed_days>1.5*m.mean_days AS overdue
FROM stage_facts f JOIN stage_means m USING(stage_code,product_type)
LEFT JOIN opportunity_forecast ofc USING(opportunity_id) WHERE NOT f.invalid_dates
),
metric_results AS (
SELECT 31 AS sort_no,'P1-02'::text AS code,'技术交流阶段超过平均周期 50% 的商机预测总量'::text AS metric_name,
NULL::text AS product_team,
(SUM(amount_yi))::numeric AS amount_yi,(SUM(energy_gwh))::numeric AS energy_gwh,(COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id))::bigint AS item_count,
(NULL)::numeric AS ratio_value,(NULL)::numeric AS days_value,'查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'::text AS status,
'超过同阶段同产品均值1.5倍；同商机每阶段只计一次；该商机期间预测先聚合后关联，不因订单或预测行重复累计。'::text AS note,(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('商机ID',opportunity_id,'产品',product_type,'周期天',elapsed_days,'均值天',mean_days)))::jsonb AS detail
FROM stage_overdue f WHERE stage_code='P1' AND in_window AND overdue
)
SELECT r.code AS "指标序号",r.metric_name AS "指标名称",r.product_team AS "产品团队",
p.start_date AS "期间开始",p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",r.item_count AS "数量",
r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
CASE WHEN r.status='查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' THEN
 CASE WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
        OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围' END ELSE r.status END AS "计算说明状态",
r.note AS "取值说明",r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results r CROSS JOIN context p ORDER BY r.sort_no,r.product_team NULLS LAST;;

P1-03.name: 客户准入平均周期
P1-03.definition: 客户.new_approved_time_facreview－客户.new_submit_time_facreview，换算天后取平均。已完成取真实结束，在途取观察截止；以本环节开始时间归所选期间。已进入后续阶段的记录也保留，不限定当前阶段枚举。
P1-03.formula: 对已实际进入本环节的有效事件计算周期；不以当前阶段枚举排除已到后续阶段的历史事件。同一事件去重，按电芯/PACK计算动态均值；单笔周期严格大于同组均值1.5倍才判超期。
P1-03.attributes:
LE05-A0217 客户.审厂申请OA通过时间（new_approved_time_facreview，空 99.97%）
LE05-A0235 客户.审厂申请OA提交时间（new_submit_time_facreview，空 99.97%）
P1-03.physicalFields:
开始：客户.new_submit_time_facreview
结束：客户.new_approved_time_facreview
样本去重：客户ID
